descriptions.tiny: Examining the disappearance and death of Taylor Williams.
descriptions.small: Examining the disappearance and death of Taylor Williams and the investigation that follows.
descriptions.medium: Examining the disappearance and death of Taylor Williams and the investigation that follows. Through interrogation footage, investigative records and courtroom developments, the film traces how a suspected cover-up unraveled and revealed the truth.

descriptions.tiny: It is lurking behind you.
descriptions.small: South Koreans fall prey to a ravenous monster that crawled out of the Han River.
descriptions.medium: A South Korean family (Song Kang-ho, Byun Hee-bong) must save a daughter (Go Ah-sung) from a horrible monster that emerged from the Han River.
descriptions.large: Careless American military personnel dump chemicals into South Korea's Han River. Several years later, a creature emerges from the tainted waters and sinks its ravenous jaws into local residents. When the creature abducts their daughter (Go Ah-sung), a vendor (Song Kang-ho) and his family decide that they are the only ones who can save her.

descriptions.tiny: Satanists plan to murder a man.
descriptions.small: A satanic group lures a man to a party in order to murder him.

descriptions.tiny: The company is making cutbacks.
descriptions.small: A killer stalks salespeople (Danny Dyer, Laura Harris) from an international arms corporation.
descriptions.medium: A killer stalks members (Danny Dyer, Laura Harris, Tim McInnerny) of a sales group from an international arms company, who have become lost in the woods during a team-building weekend.
descriptions.large: Members (Danny Dyer, Laura Harris, Tim McInnerny) of the Palisades Defense Corp. sales group arrive in Europe for a team-building exercise. A fallen tree blocks the route, and they must hike to their destination. However, a psychotic killer lurks in the woods, and he has a horrible fate in mind for each of the co-workers.

descriptions.tiny: Sing your heart out!
descriptions.small: A masked killer who despises musicals terrorizes a theater camp.
descriptions.medium: Blood begins to spill soon after the daughter (Allie MacDonald) of a Broadway diva wins the lead in the summer showcase at a performing-arts camp.

Set against the backdrop of economic crisis and bad news, an extravagant international cast of characters meet, fight, and fall in love, while hiding from the end of the world and other calamities on the tiny Greek island of Khronos.
Director's Cut of the multi-award-winning drama Punk Love. Hoping to find a better life, a drug-addicted musician (Chad Lindberg) and his young girlfriend (Emma Bing) embark on a crime spree.

descriptions.tiny: A massive meteor is on a collision course with Earth.
descriptions.small: U.S. scientist (Sean Connery) and a Soviet try to deflect an asteroid.
descriptions.medium: When the USA detects a gigantic meteor moving towards Earth, their only hope to save mankind is to use an illegal nuclear weapon satellite. However, they soon realize that they cannot do it alone.
descriptions.large: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

descriptions.medium: A young soldier unable to process the horrors of war he experienced in Iraq, returns home only to commit his own horrors.

descriptions.tiny: An underdog, mistreated by his family, seeks redemption.
descriptions.small: An underdog, mistreated by his family, is given kung fu lessons from an unlikely source.
descriptions.medium: An underdog, mistreated by his family, seeks redemption after being given kung fu lessons from an unlikely source.
descriptions.large: Nui (Cliff Lok is very enjoyable in this role, and pulls it off convincingly) is a country bumpkin with strength in excess, but a childlike ignorance of the world. After leaving his aunt, who raised him, he seeks out his father in the next town, while there he is told that his father is a servant of a celebrated general.

descriptions.small: The Department of State Security sends Capt. Chang to infiltrate a casino run by criminals.
descriptions.large: Awesome and fantastic kicking: from the Legendary Flash Legs Tan. It's China early 20th century and the country thrives on illegal gambling. The Department of State Security is sending Captain Chang (Dorian Tan) under the guise of the son of the former owner to infiltrate a casino run by criminals. Awesome and fantastic kicking: from the Legendary Flash Legs Tan.

descriptions.tiny: A Manchu spy infiltrates a Shaolin temple.
descriptions.small: A Manchu spy infiltrates a Shaolin temple to become its master.
descriptions.medium: A wrongly exiled Shaolin disciple kicks and chops his way to revenge against the villain who framed him.
descriptions.large: The Shaolin temple is in danger from the Manchu, they want to destroy the Shaolin way of life. Hope is in the balance when Rocky, the young Shaolin master's successor, falls prey to the Manchu's evil plot. Now the Shaolin must use every trick in their kung fu training to preserve their Buddhist ways.

In the Ninja Empire, there exists a secret code. Any member who disobeys any single rule will be expelled from the Empire forever. This is the story of those men and women who break this sacred code, from ambition to decadency lifestyles, and how they find redemption and forgiveness.

XM0WTG32V64ZZ4.title: Fearless Dragons aka Two on the Road

descriptions.large: A shipment of gold is stolen, and two transients are blamed. This sets the stage for a major action adventure, with some of the best names in the genre. Kung Fu superstars Philip Ko and Leung Kar Yan play the leads. They face off against Wang Lung Wei, in what many consider one of the best end fights in history. Years later, all involved said this film took something out of them! A Times Square favorite: true action.

descriptions.tiny: Half dinosaur! Half sea monster! All trouble!
descriptions.small: Deep-sea divers accidentally awaken a prehistoric predator off the coast of Belize.
descriptions.medium: A small, secluded island off the coast of Belize suddenly finds itself terrorized by a deadly predator from the planet's distant past when deep-sea divers accidentally awaken an ancient evil.

descriptions.tiny: A quest for a cancer-curing plant leads to a remote island.
descriptions.small: A quest for a cancer-curing plant leads a research expedition to a remote island.
descriptions.medium: An expedition led by a paleontologist arrives at a solitary island at sea in search of the ancient plant Fire Hell Manlotus, which is believed to cure cancer. Unexpectedly, they discover the ruins of a Jurassic habitat and traces of live dinosaurs.

descriptions.tiny: Virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake.
descriptions.small: A group of virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake.
descriptions.medium: A group of virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake, causing a young couple to fight for their lives during a peaceful fishing trip in a secluded cove.

descriptions.tiny: When divers explore the ocean, their oxygen tanks run low.
descriptions.small: When divers explore the ocean, their oxygen tanks run low as they encounter sharks and wildlife.
descriptions.medium: A group of divers set out on a journey to film and explore the beauty of the ocean. However, during their latest dive, their oxygens run low, risking their lives as they encounter sharks and other marine wildlife.
descriptions.large: Cindy and Tom (Cassidy Freeman & Mick Murray) are a newlywed couple who set out to film and explore the beauty of the ocean and the creatures within. But things take a dangerous turn on their latest dive, as they and their friend Bruce (Tim Abell) find themselves trapped in an underwater cavern. With oxygen running low and sharks circling nearby, they must stay calm, focused, and, most importantly, breathe.

descriptions.tiny: After its offspring is murdered, Bigfoot goes on a rampage.
descriptions.small: After its offspring is murdered, Bigfoot rampages through Ohio.
descriptions.large: Enraged by the murder of it's offspring, a Bigfoot rampages through the countryside of Southeast Ohio. Detective Benson, Ranger Thomas and Bigfoot researcher Hank scramble to locate the legendary creature before it attacks a group of teenagers on a camping trip in an isolated place called Kampout.

descriptions.tiny: Tracking down the owner of a Christmas time capsule.
descriptions.small: A father bonds with his daughter while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.
descriptions.medium: Following their move to a new city, a father (daniel lissing) bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an.

descriptions.tiny: Charlotte's painting is submitted to an art festival.
descriptions.small: Charlotte discovers her latest painting has been anonymously submitted to an art festival.
descriptions.medium: Over the week leading up to Christmas in the town of Bayside, Charlotte tries to capture her own unique style

descriptions.tiny: A contemporary retelling of "Little Women."
descriptions.small: A contemporary retelling of "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters.
descriptions.medium: A modern retelling of Louisa May Alcott's classic novel following the lives and loves of the March sisters in

descriptions.tiny: Jaime tries to keep a secret while pursuing a new romance.
descriptions.small: Faced with spending Christmas alone, Jamie decides to anonymously give back to her community.
descriptions.medium: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

descriptions.tiny: A search for the original owner of a WWII uniform.
descriptions.small: A professor teams with a store owner to help track down the original owner of a WWII uniform.
descriptions.medium: A professor of military history (Jill Wagner) teams with an antique store owner (Paul Greene) to help track

descriptions.tiny: Based on the terrifying affliction of sleep paralysis.
descriptions.small: From the creator of the Final Destination franchise comes the paralyzing thriller Dead Awake.
descriptions.medium: Drawing on the well-documented and infamous affliction known as sleep paralysis, "Dead Awake" is a terrifying new addition to the horror canon. With Lori Petty and Jesse Bradford.
descriptions.large: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

descriptions.tiny: A writer investigates mysterious disappearances.
descriptions.small: A writer investigates mysterious disappearances when his lover goes missing.
descriptions.medium: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

descriptions.tiny: (1959) A scientist keeps a severed head.
descriptions.small: (1959) A mad scientist keeps his fiancée's severed head alive while he searches for a suitable body.
descriptions.medium: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

descriptions.tiny: A troubled cop investigates deaths at a Wyoming clinic.
descriptions.small: An FBI agent (Sylvester Stallone) searches for a serial killer at a clinic.
descriptions.medium: In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.
descriptions.large: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

descriptions.tiny: A vicious reptile hunts the students who destroyed her nest.
descriptions.small: When a group of friends goes on a boat trip, a giant killer crocodile begins to pick them off.
descriptions.medium: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

descriptions.tiny: Bobby is haunted by his past when gets a new relationship.
descriptions.small: Bobby is haunted by his past when he enters a new relationship with Lakeisha.
descriptions.medium: Bobby, haunted by the infidelity of his ex-wife, enters a new relationship with Lakeisha while grappling with deep-seated insecurities. Unbeknownst to Lakeisha, his past resurfaces when a witness claims to have seen him involved in a murder.

descriptions.small: Yanni flees to Atlanta to seek refuge with her best friend and her ex-con boyfriend.
descriptions.medium: After years of being taken advantage of by men, Yanni flees to Atlanta to seek refuge with her best friend and her ex-con boyfriend.

descriptions.tiny: A couple is visited by a friend who is in distress.
descriptions.small: A young married couple is visited by a college friend who is in distress and has a big secret.
descriptions.medium: A young married couple has a friend from college visit them, who is in distress. She has a huge secret which ultimately spirals into a domino effect of more secrets, sex, corruption, murder and concealing the truth.

descriptions.tiny: A seductive houseguest turns a couple's life upside down.
descriptions.small: Strange events plague a young married couple when the wife's seductive childhood friend moves in.
descriptions.medium: A young married couple moves in a female childhood friend who the wife hasn't seen in years. Slowly the house guest starts seducing the ones around her and people start dying. Can anyone stop her before it's too late?

descriptions.tiny: A Golden Glove champion and his sister.
descriptions.small: An ex Golden Glove champion attempts to fix his relationship with his sister.
descriptions.medium: An ex Golden Glove champion repairs a broken bond with his sister while sabotaging a gun trafficking scheme.

descriptions.tiny: A paid audience member experiences his 15 minutes of fame.
descriptions.small: A paid audience member experiences his 15 minutes of fame after a talk show host notices him.
descriptions.medium: Eddie Krumble works as a paid audience member for infomercials and experiences a whirlwind of overnight fame after a late-night talk show host publicizes his frequent infomercial appearances.

descriptions.tiny: An actor researches a role at a barrio store.
descriptions.small: An actor (Morgan Freeman) bonds with a cashier (Paz Vega) while researching a role in a barrio.
descriptions.medium: Researching a role at a grocery store, an actor (Morgan Freeman) bonds with a feisty cashier (Paz Vega) who is preparing to interview for a new job.
descriptions.large: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

descriptions.tiny: Cruel classmates set a telekinetic teen up for a fall.
descriptions.small: Teen (Emily Bergl) discovers telekinetic powers after a friend's death.
descriptions.medium: After her best friend commits suicide, an unpopular girl discovers she has telekinetic powers and uses them to seek revenge on her humiliators.
descriptions.large: When her closest friend commits suicide after being manipulated by the popular crowd, quiet and bookish Rachel Lang (Emily Bergl) decides to get back at the guilty parties. Although Rachel falls for sensitive football player Jesse Ryan (Jason London), she remains determined to punish his callous friends. When Rachel discovers that she has superhuman abilities, it ups the stakes for her revenge, echoing a supernatural incident that occurred decades before.

descriptions.tiny: A werewolf attack brings out a teenage girl's inner beast.
descriptions.small: A werewolf attack brings out a teenage girl's (Katharine Isabelle) inner beast.
descriptions.medium: A fearsome transformation takes place after a death-obsessed teen (Katharine Isabelle) and her sister (Emily Perkins) are attacked by a supernatural beast.
descriptions.large: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

descriptions.tiny: An embezzler on the run seeks shelter at an isolated motel.
descriptions.small: A woman (Anne Heche) steals cash and stays at a madman's (Vince Vaughn) motel.
descriptions.medium: A woman (Anne Heche) steals cash at work, hits the road and stays at a desolate motel run by mad, mother-fixated Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn).
descriptions.large: Hoping for a fresh start with her broke boyfriend, Marion (Anne Heche) steals a huge sum from her boss and skips town, eventually stopping at a remote motel. There, she's served by the intensely awkward yet docile Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn), whom she often hears arguing with his domineering mother. But later that night, Marion is brutally slain, and Norman finds and hides the body. When a detective and Marion's sister visit the motel to investigate, they uncover shocking truths.

descriptions.tiny: A prisoner goes back in time to avert a deadly plague.
descriptions.small: Authorities send a prisoner (Bruce Willis) back in time to avert a plague that killed 5 billion.
descriptions.medium: A psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) finally believes a patient (Bruce Willis) who claims to be a time-traveler sent to 1996 to prevent a virulent holocaust.
descriptions.large: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

descriptions.tiny: It's time for payback ... but payback goes both ways.
descriptions.small: Four men who were abducted by aliens seek revenge for their traumatic experience.
descriptions.medium: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.
descriptions.large: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

descriptions.tiny: Everyone comes here looking for a way out.
descriptions.small: A woman encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.
descriptions.medium: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.
descriptions.large: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

descriptions.tiny: Radiation breeds a murderous tribe of misshapen humanoids.
descriptions.small: New Yorkers (John Heard, Kim Greist) face cannibalistic humanoids.
descriptions.medium: Lovers (John Heard, Kim Greist) and other New Yorkers face cannibalistic humanoid underground dwellers, spawned by toxic waste.
descriptions.large: Photographer George Cooper (John Heard) is documenting the lives of subterranean homeless people, a population that has mysteriously dwindled. After receiving information from a reporter, George becomes aware of a conspiracy theory about cannibalistic monsters lurking in the sewers. He teams up with the reporter, a policeman (Christopher Curry) and a priest (Daniel Stern) to fight two battles: one against the cannibals and the other against a corrupt government official.

descriptions.tiny: Fallen preacher Shay meets single mom Laurie.
descriptions.small: Preacher Shay, guns down his wife for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets Laurie.
descriptions.medium: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie; however, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.
descriptions.large: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

descriptions.tiny: Vote early. Vote often.
descriptions.small: A campaign manager hires a detective after a political candidate finds a dead body while fishing.
descriptions.medium: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

descriptions.tiny: A Korean War veteran gives a shy guy a new outlook on life.
descriptions.small: An outgoing Korean War veteran befriends an introspective comrade in their Indianapolis hometown.
descriptions.medium: An outgoing Korean War veteran (Ben Affleck) befriends an introspective comrade (Jeremy Davies) in their Indianapolis hometown.
descriptions.large: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

descriptions.medium: Two broken hearts-one old, one young-are about to change each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
descriptions.large: A young girl struggling with grief and a lonely woman who has shut herself off from the world find their lives unexpectedly intertwined. As the magic of Christmas weaves through their hearts, they discover that love, forgiveness, and second chances are the greatest gifts of all.

descriptions.medium: At Christmas the daughter of an ice sculptor wishes the ice princess he carved would come to life. After her wish is fulfilled, Jade, the ice princess, must convince her scultpor to accept her or she will turn back into ice.
Troy has 30 days to create the world's greatest video game or his family loses everything. No pressure.
descriptions.large: With her indie video game business on the brink of bankruptcy, Kate (Mira Sorvino) throws a Hail Mary and puts Troy (Chris Carpenter), her teenage coding genius son, in charge of creating a video game to save the company. It's a dream come true for Troy. But quite the opposite for the company's disgruntled coders (Sean Astin, Mary Lynn Rajksub, Erik Griffin) and their rival CEO (Nelson Franklin).

descriptions.medium: When agent Alison and Officer Brock find a lost baby, it'll take a miracle for them just to stop bickering.
descriptions.large: Christmas is about a miracle baby, but when CPS agent Alison and police officer Brock find a lost baby lying in a nativity scene, it'll take a miracle for them just to stop bickering. Can the magic of Christmas help this baby find a home - and maybe even help Alison and Brock see each other in a different light?

descriptions.medium: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

descriptions.small: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

descriptions.medium: Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

descriptions.small: A riches-to-rags comedy about a socialite who falls off her yacht and into a different life!
Four conniving jewel thieves compete for a fortune in jewels in this outrageously funny farce

descriptions.medium: When Molly is hired as a 9-year-old's new caretaker, it's a perfect setup for both girls to change their ways.

descriptions.small: A whip-smart comedy about two female friends and the oddball loser who may come between them.

descriptions.tiny: A white blood cell rallies against an invading germ.
descriptions.small: A white blood cell cop teams up with a cold tablet to destroy a virus.
descriptions.medium: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.
descriptions.large: A cutting-edge, live action/animated action adventure comedy about one white blood cell's (Chris Rock) race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus (Laurence Fishburne). Bill Murray stars as Frank, in whose body the action unfolds.

descriptions.small: Love threatens to come between a drunken playboy and his inheritance.

descriptions.tiny: An actress's ideal role turns into a nightmare.
descriptions.small: Actress's (Laura Herrington) life reflects satanic Broadway show she's in.
descriptions.medium: Satanic aspects of a Broadway show are reflected in the life of an actress (Laura Herrington) who is in it.

descriptions.small: A coach's daughter coaches boys football at an inner-city high school.

EP000029950175.title: The Skinny According to Nick Cullhane

descriptions.tiny: Dead writer sends a manuscript.
descriptions.small: A writer sends Jessica a kidnapping expose which results in murder.
descriptions.medium: A writer is murdered after sending Jessica a manuscript exposing a kidnapping scam, and Jessica's friend, private investigator Harry McGraw (Jerry Orbach) is caught near the body.

descriptions.tiny: Tenant found murdered in New York.
descriptions.small: Jessica learns the former tenant of her new apartment has been murdered.
descriptions.medium: Jessica takes a teaching position in New York, gets an apartment and finds its previous tenant murdered.

descriptions.tiny: Jessica races to solve campus muggings.
descriptions.small: A professor and ex-cop challenges Jessica to a race to solve a series of campus muggings.
descriptions.medium: A policeman-turned-professor challenges Jessica to solve a series of campus muggings that soon escalates to murder.

descriptions.tiny: Friend suspected in writer's death.
descriptions.small: Jessica aids an old friend who is suspected of killing an author.
descriptions.medium: A friend (Bradford Dillman) is suspected of killing the author (Jessica Walter) who was writing an unauthorized biography of his wife.

descriptions.tiny: Sheriff assumes brother is guilty.
descriptions.small: Sheriff Metzger's troublesome younger brother is suspected of murder.
descriptions.medium: Sheriff Metzger assumes his younger brother, the black sheep of the family, is guilty of murder, as charged.

descriptions.tiny: Hackers involved in blackmail.
descriptions.small: Jessica discovers a case of computer hacking that leads to murder.
descriptions.medium: New computer owner Jessica discovers hackers gathering information for blackmail, a crime that leads to murder.

descriptions.tiny: Jessica probes 20-year-old murder.
descriptions.small: Jessica probes a 20-year-old murder haunting a jazz great's family.
descriptions.medium: Jessica probes a 20-year-old unsolved murder after attending the funeral of a New Orleans jazz great.

descriptions.tiny: Jessica defends abused wife.
descriptions.small: When a friend is charged with murdering her abusive husband, Jessica tries to help.
descriptions.medium: Jessica attempts to prove a battered wife innocent of killing her husband after failing to convince the woman to defend herself.

descriptions.tiny: The Buffalo Central Terminal.
descriptions.small: TAPS visits the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal.
descriptions.medium: TAPS visits the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal, a former office tower and train station.
descriptions.large: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

descriptions.tiny: TAPS travels to St. Petersburg.
descriptions.small: TAPS travels to St. Petersburg, Fla. to investigate two notoriously haunted inns.
descriptions.large: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

descriptions.tiny: The team returns to New Orleans.
descriptions.small: The team returns to New Orleans to investigate a historic sugar plantation.
descriptions.large: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

descriptions.tiny: TAPS helps a family in Connecticut.
descriptions.small: TAPS helps a family in Connecticut whose son is terrified by spirits.
descriptions.medium: TAPS helps a family in Connecticut whose son is terrified by spirits in its home; the team investigates a winery in Appleton, N.Y.
descriptions.large: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

descriptions.tiny: Two cases in Massachusetts.
descriptions.small: TAPS investigates two cases in Massachusetts on the recommendation of team member Steve Gonsalves.
descriptions.large: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

descriptions.tiny: An investigation of the U.S.S. Hornet.
descriptions.small: Actor Colin Ferguson joins the team for an investigation of the U.S.S. Hornet in San Francisco.
descriptions.large: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

descriptions.large: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

descriptions.tiny: The TAPS team revisits their cases.
descriptions.large: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

descriptions.tiny: An exploration of the Choco in Colombia.
descriptions.large: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

descriptions.tiny: Millions of animals don't survive.
descriptions.small: For every animal born, millions don't survive, because of drought, flood, famine or predators.
descriptions.medium: For every baby animal born, millions do not survive, whether because of drought, flood, famine or predators. Babies are born into a harsh world, and their parents go to extreme efforts to ensure the survival of their offspring.
descriptions.large: For every baby animal born, billions don't make it. Drought, flood, famine and predation; babies are born into a harsh world. The odds are so heavily stacked against some animals that it's a miracle any of their youngsters survive at-all. In this episode we discover the incredible lengths that nature's parents go to in order to ensure their progeny's survival.

descriptions.tiny: The Serrania in Colombia.
descriptions.large: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

descriptions.tiny: Among Australia's Great Barrier Reef.
descriptions.small: Among Australia's natural gifts is the Great Barrier Reef, it supports a vast array of life forms.
descriptions.large: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

descriptions.tiny: An inhospitable environment.
descriptions.small: The Arctic is one of the least hospitable environments on earth.
descriptions.large: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

descriptions.small: Limited rainfall on the prairie has created a unique grassland ecosystem.
descriptions.large: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

descriptions.tiny: Asian elephants.
descriptions.small: Encounter Asian elephants in the planet's most ancient rainforests.
descriptions.large: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

Everybody loves pasta and so does Lidia. Today, she makes three dishes that viewers will love. Her first dish is an Orecchiette with Clams and Zucchini, made with scallions, pepperoncino and garlic. Her Spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers. She finishes with a unique dish of Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Saffron and Golden Raisins.

She starts by making a flavorful chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach. She then uses the stock in her succulent Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina. descriptions.medium: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

descriptions.medium: Bringing the relevant business news and up-to-date informed analysis from Singapore and around the world.

Meteorologists recap the day in weather news and forecast across America for tomorrow.

descriptions.medium: Martha fills in as the local Dear Debbie advice columnist, getting an anonymous letter that adds intrigue during a progressive dinner attended by all of our Middleton couples. Stars Catherine Bell and James Denton.

descriptions.medium: Like mother, like daughter! The enchanting Cassie Nightingale is back with daughter Grace by her side and together their spellbinding charm is no match for Middleton's newest neighbors.

descriptions.tiny: A woman arrives at the Grey House.

descriptions.medium: As Middleton's Heritage Festival gets everyone in town talking, Cassie is back to her bewitching ways as she welcomes a scared young woman to the Grey House, only to find out she's being followed.

descriptions.tiny: It's Morphin time.
descriptions.small: Five teens utilize their special powers to save the world from an alien threat.
descriptions.medium: A group of high-school students, who are infused with unique superpowers, harness their abilities in order to save the world.
descriptions.large: Five ordinary teens must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove - and the world - is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and, before it's too late, band together as the Power Rangers.

descriptions.tiny: Unlikely heroes battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits.
descriptions.small: Chaos loves company. From the producer of Uncharted, Spider-Man and Venom.
descriptions.medium: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

descriptions.tiny: Fear is reality.
descriptions.small: An agoraphobic gamer tests new AI equipment that seems to be serving a sinister force.
descriptions.medium: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

descriptions.tiny: The art of the kill.
descriptions.small: Two detectives seek help from an incarcerated serial killer when a copycat murderer strikes.
descriptions.medium: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer named the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse.
descriptions.large: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer called the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's brilliant but twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse, racing against time to stay one step ahead of both criminals.

descriptions.tiny: An amnesiac wakes up in a new body every 12 hours.
descriptions.small: A man loses his memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours, forced to discover his identity.
descriptions.medium: Unable to remember anything about his life, a man begins regaining consciousness in a new body every 12 hours. Now, he must piece together his identity, all while evading attacks from pursuing agents and dangerous criminals alike.

descriptions.tiny: The Koreans use a secret weapon against invading samurai.
descriptions.small: In 1592, with Korea in danger of falling to the Japanese navy, it resorts to a secret weapon.
descriptions.medium: In 1592, Korea faces the threat of the powerful Japanese navy. As defending Adm. Yi Sun-sin's forces fall into crisis, they resort to a secret weapon: the dragon-headed ships known as geobukseon. Using them, they hope to turn the tide of the war.

descriptions.tiny: A martial arts master takes on a crime boss (Sammo Hung).
descriptions.small: A martial arts master returns to the town where his father was murdered to take on a crime boss.
descriptions.medium: A powerful martial arts master (Eddie Peng) returns to the town where his father was murdered to take on a ruthless crime boss (Sammo Hung).

descriptions.tiny: This time, everything is on the line.
descriptions.small: Three rival gangsters wage war for control of the Philadelphia drug trade.
descriptions.large: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

descriptions.tiny: Inspired by true events.
descriptions.small: A young gay man finds unexpected strength, camaraderie and support after he joins the Marines.
descriptions.medium: Based on the incredible true story of a gay Black man with few options who joins the Marines to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that cast him aside, unexpectedly finding strength and camaraderie in this new community.
descriptions.large: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

descriptions.tiny: An ex-Marine and six young toughs mount a rescue mission.
descriptions.small: An ex-Marine prison counselor leads juvenile offenders on a mission to rescue a tycoon's daughter.
descriptions.medium: An ex-Marine prison counselor leads juvenile offenders on a mission to rescue a tycoon's daughter held hostage in Vietnam.
descriptions.large: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

descriptions.tiny: Home invaders hold a husband and wife hostage.
descriptions.small: As they're held for ransom, a husband and wife's predicament grows more dire.
descriptions.medium: As they're held for ransom, a husband and wife's predicament grows more dire amid the discovery of betrayal and deception.
descriptions.large: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

descriptions.tiny: A troubled cop investigates deaths at a Wyoming clinic.
descriptions.small: An FBI agent (Sylvester Stallone) searches for a serial killer at a clinic.
descriptions.medium: An alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic when a serial killer targets him.
descriptions.large: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

descriptions.small: A research program once abandoned by the Pentagon has been resumed by its former deputy.
descriptions.medium: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

descriptions.tiny: A model takes a drug causing a transformation.
descriptions.small: In a future with toxic air, a model takes a drug causing a transformation.
descriptions.medium: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

descriptions.tiny: A woman reunites her posse to avenge her sister's murder.
descriptions.small: The former leader of a disbanded all-female gang calls her comrades back to the saddle.
descriptions.medium: In this action-packed Western, the former leader of a disbanded all-female gang calls her comrades back to the saddle to hunt down hidden treasure and avenge the death of her sister.
descriptions.large: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

descriptions.medium: Documentary in which whistleblowers and experts claim to bring viewers face-to-face with extraterrestrial visitors and their message for humanity.

descriptions.medium: In 1973, Calvin Parker claimed he was abducted by aliens in Mississippi; his account is examined with new evidence and expert analysis.

descriptions.medium: In October 1973, a quiet evening on the Pascagoula River turned into a controversial UFO encounter; revisit the Pascagoula case through a blend of archival footage, newly uncovered evidence and expert analysis.

descriptions.medium: The world of Chef Masaki Saito, Canada's first Michelin two-star chef, exploring his groundbreaking approach to Omakase dining and revealing the intense lifestyle driving his culinary genius.

descriptions.small: The magical world of fungi and their power to contribute to the regeneration of life on Earth.

descriptions.medium: A doctor (Tom Hiddleston) moves into a London skyscraper where rising tensions and class warfare lead to anarchy.

A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

Shaina lives 600 years in the future. She's read about poverty, oppression, and violence in history books. When she accidentally time travels to our times, she assumes that everyone is caring and honest as she tries to recruit help to get back home.

descriptions.large: A Royal prince is hiding out in the Shaolin Temple. The evil Empress employs a band of ruthless Manchu fighters and Japanese Ninjas to try to force the prince to come out of the temple. But the little mighty monks of Shaolin prove too powerful for them. The prince is safe and will soon become the Emperor of China.

descriptions.tiny: A martial arts student is expelled from his school.

descriptions.large: Ah Chi (Ka-Yan Leung) is obsessed with the martial arts, and more often than not, his kung-fu clowning gets him into trouble. Ending up facing Hsia (Eddie Ko) of the notorious Jade Brotherhood is inevitable. As a result, Hsia forces Chi's martial arts master to expel him. Master less and working for a fish vendor, Chi meets a crafty kid (Wong Yat Lung), who's Uncle Chow Tung (Yuet Sang Chin) is a master of the insane Mantis style.

descriptions.tiny: Kung-fu hero recovers crown jewel in Hong Kong.
descriptions.large: This is the tale of a vengeful Interpol agent and master of the Eagle Claw kung fu named Tiger (Bruce Li) whose brother was killed mercilessly. Tiger now turns up with a lady cop named Sergeant Li (Christina Chung) and together they become a nightmare for the thugs and smugglers of Hong Kong.

The story revolves around a man attempting to escape his criminal past only to be drawn into an organized crime war over a stolen diamond. Enter a Caucasian insurance investigator in Hong Kong hired to apparently track down the same diamond which the ninja is also interested in.

descriptions.medium: While cataloguing World War 2 relics in a newly declassified British military site, a group of archaeologists unleash an ancient evil.

With the help of 3 archaeologists they discover a hidden room that holds a mysterious box, but when that box is opened... they awaken an ancient evil. Now they must use their wits and knowledge to survive the night!

descriptions.medium: What begins as a carefree bachelorette trip becomes a nightmare when a starving tiger locks onto the women as its next prey, forcing them into a brutal battle to survive.
