descriptions.tiny: Four friends cross paths with a demonic temptress.
descriptions.small: English noble (Hugh Grant) links skull, dragon legend, vampiress (Amanda Donohoe).
descriptions.medium: An English nobleman (Hugh Grant) links a skull and a dragon legend to a vampire temptress (Amanda Donohoe).
descriptions.large: On a farm owned by Eve Trent (Catherine Oxenberg) and her sister Mary (Sammi Davis), young archaeologist Angus Flint (Peter Capaldi) discovers a large and inexplicable skull, which he soon deduces belonged to the D'Ampton Worm, a mythical beast supposedly slain generations ago by the ancestor of the current Lord D'Ampton (Hugh Grant). The predatory Lady Sylvia Marsh (Amanda Donohoe) soon takes an interest in both Flint and the virginal Eve, hinting that the vicious D'Ampton Worm may still live.

descriptions.tiny: A serial killer implicates a new policewoman in his deeds.
descriptions.small: Police rookie (Jamie Lee Curtis) loses badge, gains lover (Ron Silver), hunts killer.
descriptions.medium: A police rookie (Jamie Lee Curtis) loses her badge, gains a boyfriend (Ron Silver) and hunts a killer who uses a .44-caliber Magnum.
descriptions.large: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

descriptions.tiny: La historia de una mujer que deja el amor por el dinero.
descriptions.small: La historia de una mujer que entrega amor por dinero, pero pronto descubre que fue un error.
descriptions.medium: La historia de una mujer que entrega amor por dinero, pero pronto descubre que fue un error y que ya no podrá arreglarlo.

descriptions.tiny: Un hombre es acusado de un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente.
descriptions.small: Luego de abandonar la prisión, la mala suerte persigue a un hombre.
descriptions.medium: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

descriptions.tiny: Un vagabundo se encuentra en casa de una familia de ricos.
descriptions.small: Una mujer recoge a un vagabundo y lo emplea sin saber que él tiene otra identidad.
descriptions.medium: Un vagabundo se encuentra en la casa de una mujer que piensa reformarlo, ignorando que él no es lo que aparenta.

MV000414520000.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound

descriptions.tiny: Gillespie's enemies peg a businessman to run for sheriff.
descriptions.small: Businessman runs against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.
descriptions.medium: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

descriptions.tiny: Genetically engineered piranha head for a resort.
descriptions.small: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river.
descriptions.medium: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

descriptions.tiny: A teenage sleuth latches onto a serial killer's trail.
descriptions.small: Police cadet (Kevin Dillon) and teen sleuth (Alicia Silverstone) probe student's murder.
descriptions.medium: A teen sleuth (Alicia Silverstone) thinks a classmate's murder is part of a series of West Coast slayings linked to a traveling carnival.
descriptions.large: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

descriptions.tiny: A psychic hustler encounters a genuine supernatural threat.
descriptions.small: A psychic detective (Michael J. Fox) probes supernatural killings.
descriptions.medium: Friendly ghosts help a psychic detective (Michael J. Fox) probe the hauntings that killed residents of a coastal California town.
descriptions.large: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

descriptions.tiny: A former government operative tracks a serial killer.
descriptions.small: LAPD detective (Steven Seagal) links serial murders to tycoon (Bob Gunton).
descriptions.medium: An LAPD detective (Steven Seagal) links murders blamed on a serial killer to a tycoon (Bob Gunton) eliminating business associates.
descriptions.large: A former government operative renowned for his stealth, Jack Cole (Steven Seagal) is now a Los Angeles police detective. When a series of horrible murders occurs in the metro area, Cole is assigned to the case, along with tough-talking fellow cop Jim Campbell (Keenen Ivory Wayans). Although the two men clash, they gradually become effective partners as they uncover a conspiracy linked to the killings, which also involves terrorism and organized crime.

descriptions.tiny: A military sharpshooter must evade a massive manhunt.
descriptions.small: A commander (Jon Voight) recruits a condemned Marine (Keenen Ivory Wayans) for a mission.
descriptions.medium: Convicted of murder, a condemned Marine (Keenen Ivory Wayans) is rescued and recruited by the commander (Jon Voight) of a secret squad.
descriptions.large: U.S. Sgt. Dunn (Keenen Ivory Wayans) is sentenced to death for a crime he didn't commit, but he gets a second chance when Lt. Col. Grant Casey (Jon Voight) handpicks him for a dangerous secret mission. Unfortunately, Dunn soon finds out that his assignment is a setup, and he is framed for the murder of the president's wife. Dunn goes on the run from the law with Dr. Constantini (Jill Hennessy), who knows the true identity of the assassin. But Casey will do anything to silence the pair.

descriptions.tiny: A hit woman and her partner flee a displeased crime boss.
descriptions.small: A crime boss pursues his girlfriend and gangsters (Kyra Sedgwick, Stanley Tucci).
descriptions.medium: A crime boss pursues his girlfriend and two blackmailed gang members (Kyra Sedgwick, Stanley Tucci) trying to nab her.

descriptions.tiny: Cuatro fugitivos quieren rehabitar un poblado abandonado.
descriptions.small: Western mexicano influenciado por diferentes filmes extranjeros.
descriptions.medium: Cuatro sentenciados a muerte se fugan a un pueblo abandonado, juntos liberan presos para poblar con ellos el lugar.

descriptions.tiny: The one thing that could bring them together is revenge.
descriptions.small: A process server helps his latest mark turn the tables on her rich and unfaithful husband.
descriptions.medium: A woman (Elizabeth Hurley) tries to persuade a process server (Matthew Perry) to help her turn the tables on her conniving husband (Bruce Campbell).
descriptions.large: When Sara (Elizabeth Hurley) is served divorce papers while she is in New York, she is stunned. Not about to lose the fortune she amassed with her self-serving Texan husband, she makes an offer to her process server, Joe (Matthew Perry), that sets them off on a wild trip across the country.

descriptions.tiny: Un padre quiere casar a una de sus dos hijas con un conde.
descriptions.small: Un padre desea casar a una de sus dos bellas hijas con un conde.
descriptions.medium: Un padre desea casar a una de sus dos bellas hijas con un conde, para ello alquila una mansión y contrata a dos criados.

MV001268290000.title: Cómo atrapar a un don Juan

descriptions.tiny: Un estafador planea la evacuación de capital a Ginebra.
descriptions.small: Un estafador organiza la evacuación de capitales a Ginebra para quedarse con el dinero.
descriptions.medium: Un estafador organiza la evacuación de capitales a Ginebra para quedarse con el dinero ganado en especulaciones.

descriptions.tiny: Un padre se interpone en el amor de su hija por su primo.
descriptions.small: Unos primos se enamoran y desean casarse, pero el padre de la mujer se opone.
descriptions.medium: Eugenia Grandet se enamora de su primo Carlos y, cuando desean formalizar su compromiso, el padre de Eugenia se opone porque sospecha que el novio solo busca su fortuna.

descriptions.tiny: Un ranchero se disfraza como un bandido justiciero.
descriptions.small: Un ranchero se disfraza como un bandido generoso y asesina a un recaudador de impuestos.
descriptions.medium: Un ranchero se disfraza como un bandido generoso y asesina a un recaudador de impuestos, pero es descubierto.

descriptions.tiny: Siblings seek revenge for their adoptive mother's murder.
descriptions.small: Diverse siblings reunite for revenge after learning about the murder of their adoptive mother.
descriptions.medium: Diverse siblings (Mark Wahlberg, Tyrese Gibson, André Benjamin) reunite for revenge after learning about the murder of their adoptive mother.
descriptions.large: When an inner-city Detroit foster mother (Fionnula Flanagan) is murdered in a botched holdup, four of her now-grown adopted children suspect it was no random killing. Rising musician Jack (Garrett Hedlund), former-Marine Angel (Tyrese Gibson), hotheaded hockey player Bobby (Mark Wahlberg) and settled-down husband and father Jeremiah (André Benjamin) go on the hunt for neighborhood criminal kingpin Victor Sweet (Chiwetel Ejiofor) while being trailed themselves by the local beat cops.

descriptions.tiny: Where there's a will, there's a weapon.
descriptions.small: A relentless Interpol agent tracks an arms dealer (Nicolas Cage).
descriptions.medium: A relentless Interpol agent tracks an arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) trying to stay one step ahead of his business rivals.
descriptions.large: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).

descriptions.tiny: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against her undead sire.
descriptions.small: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.
descriptions.large: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

MV001780990000.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: One for the Road

descriptions.tiny: Comics Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall.
descriptions.small: Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall and Ron White perform their stand-up routines.
descriptions.medium: Comics Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall and Ron White perform their stand-up routines.

descriptions.tiny: A dragonfly bite turns a teen loser into a hero.
descriptions.small: A bite from a genetically altered bug gives a teenage loser (Drake Bell) superhuman abilities.
descriptions.medium: A teenage loser (Drake Bell) transforms into a caped crusader when a bite from a genetically altered bug gives him superhuman abilities.
descriptions.large: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

descriptions.small: Kevin and Shirley want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with family.
descriptions.medium: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

descriptions.tiny: Three women plan to steal cash that is due for destruction.
descriptions.small: Three women conspire to steal currency that the Federal Reserve has earmarked for destruction.
descriptions.medium: Three women (Diane Keaton, Queen Latifah, Katie Holmes) conspire to steal a pile of cash that the Federal Reserve Bank has earmarked for destruction.
descriptions.large: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

descriptions.tiny: Two children scheme to reunite their estranged parents.
descriptions.small: Two children scheme to reunite their estranged parents (Cynthia Gibb, David Millbern).
descriptions.medium: Two children scheme to reunite their estranged parents (Cynthia Gibb, David Millbern) during a school holiday.

descriptions.tiny: Your favorite movies are going to be destroyed.
descriptions.small: A group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings must dodge catastrophic events.
descriptions.medium: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters.
descriptions.large: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings (Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian) must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters. Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety.

descriptions.tiny: An outcast boy (Kåre Hedebrant) befriends a vampire child.
descriptions.small: A lonely misfit (Kåre Hedebrant) finds a soul mate in a vampire child (Lina Leandersson).
descriptions.medium: A lonely misfit (Kåre Hedebrant) finds a soul mate in the form of a vampire child (Lina Leandersson) who recently became his neighbor.
descriptions.large: When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

descriptions.tiny: Assume the position.
descriptions.small: A stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker arrive in the desert to extort a kingpin.
descriptions.medium: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

descriptions.tiny: Two agents. One city. No mercy.
descriptions.small: A low-ranking agent joins forces with a dynamic operative to stop a terrorist attack in France.
descriptions.medium: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.
descriptions.large: James Reese (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) has a good job as an ambassador's aid in France, but his real passion is a side gig, working in a minor role in the CIA. He would love to be a full-fledged agent and can't believe his luck when he lands an assignment with Charlie Wax (John Travolta). Trigger-happy Charlie soon has James crying for his desk job, but when he learns that the same guys they're trying to catch are after him, James realizes that Charlie may be his only hope of survival.

descriptions.tiny: A psychologist uncovers evidence of alien abductions.
descriptions.small: There are four kinds of alien encounters. The fourth kind is abduction.
descriptions.medium: During videotaped sessions with her patients, a psychologist (Milla Jovovich) in Alaska uncovers disturbing evidence of alien abductions.
descriptions.large: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

descriptions.tiny: If you believe in God, you must believe in the devil.
descriptions.small: A deceitful cleric (Patrick Fabian) must summon faith when he finds real evil at a Louisiana farm.
descriptions.medium: While a film crew documents his final days as an exorcist, a deceitful cleric (Patrick Fabian) must summon true faith when he encounters real evil at a Louisiana farm.
descriptions.large: After years of gulling the faithful, cleric Cotton Marcus feels remorse and decides to expose his chicanery through filming a documentary. With a crew in tow, Marcus arrives at the Louisiana farm of devout Louis Sweetzer, who believes that his daughter, Nell, is possessed. When the usual stunts fail, he realizes that he is face-to-face with real evil and must summon true faith to protect Nell, the others and himself from demonic power.

descriptions.tiny: What if you had 72 hours to save everything you live for?
descriptions.small: After his imprisoned wife becomes suicidal, a man (Russell Crowe) hatches a plan to break her out.
descriptions.medium: A man fails in his attempts to establish his wife's innocence of murder, and she has no appeals left, so he (Russell Crowe) hatches an elaborate plan to break her out of prison.
descriptions.large: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

descriptions.tiny: The world will be watching.
descriptions.small: In a place once known as North America, youths fight to the death in a nationally televised contest.
descriptions.medium: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.
descriptions.large: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

descriptions.small: Stephanie and Marc been outbid on properties in the city, and are frustrated with house hunting.
descriptions.medium: Stephanie and Marc are getting frustrated with their house hunt. They've been outbid on a series of properties in the city, and the Property Brothers try to sell them on a radically different approach.

descriptions.tiny: Rayne puts the bite on Nazis during World War II.
descriptions.small: Vampire hybrid Rayne meets a Nazi leader who wants to inject Hitler with her blood.
descriptions.medium: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

EP064113830004.title: Eclectic Louisiana Home of Textile Designer Rebecca Vizard

descriptions.tiny: Tour Rebecca Vizard's Louisiana home.
descriptions.small: Rebecca Vizard's creative spirit thrives in every corner of this Louisiana Delta house.
descriptions.medium: Journey to the Louisiana Delta for a look inside the home of Rebecca Vizard; from rooms draped in rich historic textiles to a whimsical "movie wagon" repurposed from a trailer base, Rebecca's creative spirit thrives in every corner of the house.

MV003655270000.title: La Sombra en defensa de la juventud

descriptions.tiny: El luchador enmascarado "La Sombra" ayuda a los jóvenes.
descriptions.small: Un luchador enmascarado se preocupa por los jóvenes y se enfrenta a la delincuencia organizada.
descriptions.medium: El luchador enmascarado 'La Sombra' se preocupa por los jóvenes y por ello se enfrenta a la delincuencia organizada.

descriptions.tiny: An anthology details 26 ways to die.
descriptions.small: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die.
descriptions.medium: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

descriptions.tiny: A woman develops an unexpected attraction to an old friend.
descriptions.small: A woman (Rachel Boston) develops an unexpected attraction to an old friend from school.
descriptions.medium: Returning home for Christmas, a woman (Rachel Boston) develops an unexpected attraction to her best friend from school.

descriptions.tiny: A radio DJ slowly goes insane after playing a record.
descriptions.small: Nightmarish visions of vengeful witches plague a radio DJ after she plays a record by "The Lords."
descriptions.medium: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

descriptions.tiny: A vampire threatens her sister's love affair.
descriptions.small: A cruel, sex-crazed vampire threatens her sister's love affair with a writer.
descriptions.medium: When a handsome young writer falls for a gorgeous, seductive vampire, their wild romance seems destined for the ages -- until the appearance of her cruel, sex-crazed sister threatens to unravel it all.

descriptions.tiny: Complications arise during a hostage situation at a diner.
descriptions.small: Complications arise during a dangerous hostage situation at a diner.
descriptions.medium: A robbery turns into a tense hostage situation when three gunmen hold up a diner the mob uses as a front.

descriptions.tiny: Be careful who you work for.
descriptions.small: A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run.
descriptions.medium: A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.

descriptions.tiny: Awesome night. Epic aftermath.
descriptions.small: An ill-advised tryst leaves a woman stranded in downtown L.A. just hours before a job interview.
descriptions.medium: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.
descriptions.large: Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

descriptions.tiny: Live to tell the story.
descriptions.small: Navy SEALs embark on an ill-fated mission to capture or kill a notorious al-Qaeda operative.
descriptions.medium: In the mountains of Afghanistan, a squad of Taliban fighters ambushes four Navy SEALs, who are there on a mission to eliminate a high-ranking al-Qaeda operative.
descriptions.large: In 2005 Afghanistan, Navy SEALs Marcus Luttrell (Mark Wahlberg), Michael Murphy (Taylor Kitsch), Danny Dietz (Emile Hirsch) and Matthew "Axe" Axelson (Ben Foster) deploy on a mission of surveillance and to take out Taliban leader Ahmad Shah. Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

descriptions.tiny: Se pone en duda un suicidio.
descriptions.small: Un padre pone en duda el suicidio de su hija al comprobar el estado de la relación con su esposo.
descriptions.medium: Un padre pone en duda el supuesto suicidio de su hija, al comprobar el estado de la relación con su esposo y hallar pistas clave sobre su muerte tras caer de la ventana de un penthouse.

descriptions.tiny: Horns grow from the head of a man whose lover was murdered.
descriptions.small: A horned man (Daniel Radcliffe) uses his new supernatural powers to find his girlfriend's killer.
descriptions.medium: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

descriptions.tiny: Violent students harass teachers in a Los Angeles school.
descriptions.small: A Los Angeles teacher (Samuel L. Jackson) confronts violent students.
descriptions.medium: A Los Angeles high-school teacher (Samuel L. Jackson) confronts violent students with a grudge against him and society.
descriptions.large: When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

descriptions.tiny: A woman brings the Christmas spirit back to her store.
descriptions.small: A woman (Ashley Williams) tries to bring the Christmas spirit back to her department store.
descriptions.medium: To help her daughter during the holidays, a woman (Ashley Williams) tries to bring the Christmas spirit back to her department store.

descriptions.tiny: Fire burns brighter in the darkness.
descriptions.small: Katniss finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.
descriptions.medium: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.
descriptions.large: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

descriptions.tiny: Fighters shepherd a woman across war-torn Afghanistan.
descriptions.small: An officer and his team must escort a woman across war-torn Afghanistan.
descriptions.medium: Without tanks or air support, a corporal and his team must muster all the courage and firepower they can to fight their way across war-torn Afghanistan and shepherd an important anti-Taliban woman to safety.

descriptions.tiny: Some people never learn.
descriptions.small: An anthology chronicles another 26 ways to meet your maker, one for each letter of the alphabet.
descriptions.medium: Twenty-six filmmakers from around the globe helm stories that detail 26 ways to meet your maker, each one corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

descriptions.tiny: Nothing can prepare you for the end.
descriptions.small: Katniss and friends embark on a mission to assassinate President Snow and liberate war-torn Panem.
descriptions.medium: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.
descriptions.large: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

descriptions.tiny: A man becomes snowbound with his ex-wife and her suitor.
descriptions.small: A man becomes snowbound with his ex-wife, her suitor, his former mother-in-law and his daughter.
descriptions.medium: During a blizzard at Christmastime, a man (Dean Cain) becomes snowbound with his ex-wife (Kristy Swanson), her wealthy suitor (Lochlyn Munro), his former mother-in-law and his daughter.

descriptions.tiny: What began as an accident has become a deadly game.
descriptions.small: A wealthy hunter tries to kill his guide to ensure the latter's silence regarding a man's death.
descriptions.medium: In the Mojave Desert, a naked and unarmed hunting guide (Jeremy Irvine) runs from a wealthy hunter (Michael Douglas) who wants to ensure his silence in the death of an old man.

descriptions.tiny: Scientists work to stop future outer space catastrophes.
descriptions.small: Scientists work to predict and stop future outer space catastrophes.

descriptions.tiny: No más. No surrender. The true story of Roberto Durán.
descriptions.small: Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán develops a fierce rivalry with American fighter Sugar Ray Leonard.
descriptions.medium: Coached by legendary trainer Ray Arcel (Robert De Niro), Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán (Edgar Ramírez) develops a fierce rivalry with American fighter Sugar Ray Leonard (Usher Raymond IV).
descriptions.large: At age 72, legendary trainer Ray Arcel (Robert De Niro) comes out of retirement to coach world-class Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán (Edgar Ramírez). Arcel becomes a mentor to the ferocious fighter, convincing him that winning ultimately comes down to strategy. After scoring knockout after knockout, Duran prepares for a bout against Sugar Ray Leonard, the undefeated lightweight champion. descriptions.tiny: Who will progress? Let the desserts decide here.
descriptions.large: It's the chefs' last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the 'Great British Menu' judging panel. Which dessert will it be? Chris Fearon's dish inspired by comedy legend Tommy Cooper called 'Just Like That?' competes against Raymond McArdle's 'Chocolate Volcano Mountain' and Ian Orr's 'Passion Egg'.

descriptions.tiny: Fish is on the menu for the Northern Irish chefs.
descriptions.small: Chris Fearon, Raymond McArdle and Ian Orr cook their fish courses.
descriptions.large: The three Northern Ireland chefs cook their fish courses. Chris Fearon serves up a creation called 'Stitched up Like a Kipper', while Raymond McArdle draws inspiration from a view from home and serves turbot called 'A Day at the Beach'. Ian Orr creates a dish with a play on an old joke called 'Why Did the Scallop Cross the Roe'.

descriptions.small: Who will cook their entire menus for the 'Great British Menu' judges?
descriptions.large: It's decision time for the chefs from Northern Ireland. One chef has left the competition and only two remain. Who will cook their entire menus for the 'Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton? They will be joined by celebrity guest judge writer and performer Charlie Higson and the judges aren't easily pleased.

descriptions.small: Respective main courses are prepared and presented by the Northern Irish chefs.
descriptions.medium: It's time for the main course. Chris Fearon's dish called 'Cowboy Supper' is inspired by the Wild West. Raymond McArdle creates a dish called 'Titanic Smoked Venison, Tongue and Cheek', and Ian Orr cooks lamb and baked hay.

EP011113300120.title: A Single Mom and Her Daughter Look for a New Apartment

descriptions.tiny: A mother and daughter's new place.
It's time for fish as the Welsh chefs aim to impress.
descriptions.small: The chefs from Wales prepare their fish dishes, featuring grilled mackerel, lobster and fish finger.
descriptions.large: The Welsh chefs cook their fish course. Richard Davies serves up grilled and tartare of mackerel, while Mary Ann Gilchrist serves a lobster dish and calls it 'The Great Escape'. Luke Thomas is hoping that his quirky take on a classic fish finger will impress veteran Jeremy Lee too.

EP011434542568.title: How to Be Comfortable in God's Presence

descriptions.tiny: Real truths for real life.
descriptions.small: Real truths for real life, discover clarity, purpose and a better way to live every day.

descriptions.tiny: The Welsh chefs present their main courses this time around.
descriptions.small: The Welsh chefs prepare their main courses, featuring pork and beef dishes.
descriptions.large: The Welsh chefs prepare their main courses, but will any of them impress veteran Jeremy Lee enough to give them a top score? Richard Davies's dish is simply called 'A Tasting of Pork', Mary Ann Gilchrist's 'Three's a Crowd' doesn't give much away, while Luke Thomas's dish is called 'Beef, Bone Marrow and Watercress'.

descriptions.small: The chefs representing Wales present their respective starter menus.
descriptions.large: The Welsh chefs raise the curtain with their starters, but which one is going to produce a showstopper? All three contestants have created sophisticated plates of food with simple dish titles. Will veteran Jeremy Lee be impressed with Richard Davies's chicken salad or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's peas and ham or Luke Thomas's ham, egg and pineapple get them off to a flying start?

descriptions.small: The desserts are presented and comedy writer Charlie Higson joins the judging panel.
descriptions.large: It's judgement day as the chefs not only learn the top three desserts, but the judges announce the winning menu. 'Fast Show' writer and performer Charlie Higson helps judge the puddings. Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort decide on the four winning dishes, but there is a problem - they are torn between two dishes for one of the courses.

descriptions.small: Impressionist Ronni Ancona joins the judges while the chefs prepare fish recipes.
descriptions.medium: The chefs cook their fish courses. Who will make it to the top three and the special banquet? Tensions are high, but a Sicilian influenced dish called the 'Cod Father' brings some laughs. Impressionist Ronni Ancona joins the judges.

descriptions.small: Actress Patricia Hodge tastes the eight winning regional starter courses that are presented.
descriptions.medium: Renowned actress Patricia Hodge, one of the stars of British sitcom "Miranda", joins judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort to taste all eight winning regional starter courses.

descriptions.small: It's time for the climax - the Comic Relief Banquet at the Royal Albert Hall.
descriptions.medium: It's the climax of the competition as the winning chefs cook for the Comic Relief Banquet at the Royal Albert Hall. Richard Curtis welcomes the unsung heroes, beneficiaries and celebrities who have inspired us to do something funny for money.

descriptions.small: Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell attempt to impress this week's veteran judge.
descriptions.medium: Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

descriptions.tiny: Team USA takes on the world.
descriptions.small: Drew Drechsel and Jesse Labreck lead Team USA in a battle for worldwide ninja domination.
descriptions.medium: Drew Drechsel, Jesse Labreck, Mathis "The Kid" Owhadi, Najee Richardson and Barclay Stockett represent Team USA against top athletes from Europe and Australia in a battle for worldwide ninja domination.

descriptions.small: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course.
descriptions.medium: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course. Graham is in a confident mood but returning finalist Jak and self-taught Jimmy are pushing him hard. Will the pressure prove too much for ambitious Graham?

descriptions.small: The Scottish chefs are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef.
descriptions.medium: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

descriptions.small: Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold go head-to-head with their starter courses.
descriptions.medium: Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Former champion Chris is back for glory and determined to reach the banquet.
descriptions.large: Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Former champion Chris is back for glory and determined to reach the banquet, but he's up against two newcomers with their sights firmly set on victory.

descriptions.tiny: The finals return to Las Vegas.

descriptions.medium: The finals return to Las Vegas, where the ninjas face up to eight super-sized obstacles; for the first time in finals history competitors must decide between a grueling upper body obstacle and a riskier balance obstacle in hopes of advancing.

descriptions.small: Chefs Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold are cooking their fish courses.
descriptions.medium: Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold are cooking their fish courses. Ambitious Ben is determined to steal Chris's regional crown, but under fierce scrutiny from this week's formidable veteran, will the pressure to deliver spell melt down?

descriptions.small: It's a battle for the main course for three of Northern Ireland's finest chefs.
descriptions.medium: It's a battle for the main course for three of Northern Ireland's finest chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold. Ambitious Ben is out to prove himself with a perfect lamb main course.

descriptions.small: It's dessert day and the Northern Irish chefs are all striving for a spot in the Regional Final.
descriptions.medium: It's dessert day and the Northern Irish chefs are all striving for one of the two spots in the Regional Final. The pressure is intense, and in the end one chef must leave the competition empty-handed.

descriptions.small: The two remaining North Irish chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges.
descriptions.medium: The two remaining North Irish chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - award-winning food writer Felicity Cloake.

descriptions.large: It's the fight for the fish course, as three of the North East's finest chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - are out to impress. After his risky starter caused a stir yesterday Michael is planning another controversial dish in honour of the WI's support of women's rights.

descriptions.small: Three of the North East's most dynamic chefs go head-to-head cooking their main courses.
descriptions.medium: Three of the North East's most dynamic chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - go head-to-head cooking their main courses. Michelin-starred Tim is super keen to bag the first ten of the week, but Michael and Mini are hot on his heels.

descriptions.small: It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course.
descriptions.medium: It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course. It's been a week of highs and lows, modern audacious dishes and classic masterpieces but with only two places up for grabs, who will leave the competition empty-handed?
descriptions.large: It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course. It's been a week of highs and lows, modern audacious dishes and classic masterpieces but with only two places up for grabs cooking for the judges, at the end of today who will leave the competition empty-handed?

descriptions.medium: The two remaining North East chefs must cook all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - WI president Kirsty Bowen from Sheffield - who will help decide.
descriptions.large: The two remaining North East chefs must cook all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - WI president Kirsty Bowen from Sheffield - who will help decide which chef will go through to represent the North East in the National Finals.

descriptions.small: Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis.
descriptions.medium: Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis. Today's the starter course, and after failing to cook for the judges last year Mark's out to redeem himself, but he faces stiff competition.
descriptions.large: Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis. Today's the starter course, and after failing to cook for the judges last year Mark's out to redeem himself, but he faces stiff competition in executive chef Eve and young gun Matt.

descriptions.small: It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs go head-to-head.
descriptions.medium: It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis - go head-to-head. Eve and Matt are hoping their classic approach to cooking fish will win the day.
descriptions.large: It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis - go head-to-head. Eve and Matt are hoping their classic approach to cooking fish will win the day whilst Mark is going all out with a fishy take on a traditional dessert recipe.

descriptions.small: It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs.
descriptions.medium: It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis.
descriptions.large: It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis. Mark remains determined and focused on his battle to get to judges chamber this year, but as the pressure to plate up perfection reaches fever pitch, will all three chefs get a dish to the pass?

descriptions.small: It's the North West chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course.
descriptions.medium: It's the North West chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow. It's the end of the road for one chef, but who will it be?

descriptions.small: It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs.
descriptions.medium: It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt Gillan is determined to make it to this year's banquet.
descriptions.large: It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt Gillan is determined to make it to this year's banquet, but he faces fierce competition in the two newcomers.

descriptions.small: The London and South East chefs go head-to-head with their fish courses.
descriptions.medium: The London and South East chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund - go head-to-head with their fish courses. Lee is hoping his modern plate of mackerel and passion fruit will outclass Matt and Mark's dishes.
descriptions.large: The London and South East chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund - go head-to-head with their fish courses. Lee is hoping his modern plate of mackerel and passion fruit will outclass Matt and Mark's more traditionally inspired salmon dishes.

descriptions.small: It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs.
descriptions.medium: It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt is determined to bring home a 10 with his ambitious celebration of the billy goat.
descriptions.large: It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt is determined to bring home a 10 with his ambitious celebration of the billy goat but has he bitten off more than he can chew?

descriptions.small: It's dessert day and the London and South East chefs strive to secure a spot in the Regional Final.
descriptions.medium: It's dessert day and the London and South East chefs are striving to secure one of the two spots in tomorrow's Regional Final. The scores are close, so it's all to play for, as today marks the end of the competition for one man.

descriptions.small: The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges.
descriptions.medium: The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by Mary Gwynn, author of the official WI centenary cookbook.
descriptions.large: The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by Mary Gwynn, author of the official WI centenary cookbook. Together they'll decide which chef goes through to represent the region in the National Finals.

descriptions.medium: It's a battle for the main course with three Central Region chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett. Once again Jason is taking risks with his unusual collection of ingredients.

EP012378300212.title: Capts. Scott Walker & Chris Walter Fish Deep Structure

descriptions.medium: Captain Scott Walker and his former mate Captain Chris Walter take the Invincible catamaran out of Hawks Cay to fish in deep structures, looking for varieties of snapper that Chris can cook for dinner.

They'll be joined by former chair of the Women's Institute Helen Carey, who will help decide who will have the glory of representing the region in the National Finals.

EP012378300214.title: Capt. Scott Targets Big Fish on Heavy Tackle With Capt. Chris Walter

descriptions.medium: Captain Scott Walker and his former mate Captain Chris Walter test all of their gear by targeting big grouper.

descriptions.medium: It's the battle for the fish course. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist with their starters are hoping to do better. The judges are joined by Kristy Bowen, who knows the impeccable standards the WI will expect.

descriptions.tiny: It's main course day, the half-way point in Finals Week.
descriptions.small: It's main course day, and chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat.
descriptions.medium: It's main course day, and those chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat. With only dishes judged to be perfect in with a chance at reaching the WI banquet, the standards are higher than ever before.
descriptions.large: It's main course day, the half-way point in Finals Week, and those chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat. With only dishes judged to be perfect in with a chance at reaching the WI banquet, the standards are higher than ever before.

descriptions.small: When a man is shot in his home, Barnaby and Jones search for the killer.
descriptions.medium: After a council clerk is found dead, Barnaby and Jones head to Fennacomobe Bay searching for clues to his murder.
descriptions.large: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

descriptions.small: The death of an aristocrat becomes suspicious after his will disappears, and his lawyer is killed.
descriptions.medium: The death of an aristocrat becomes suspicious after his will disappears, and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack.
descriptions.large: The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

descriptions.small: The residents of Aspern Tallow believe that a ghost is at large in their community.
descriptions.medium: Mysterious events lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural.
descriptions.large: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural or if there is a more rational explanation.

descriptions.small: Casos de crímenes controversiales, entrevistas e información clave sobre evidencias.
descriptions.medium: La Dra. Ana María Polo investiga casos de crímenes controversiales, con entrevistas e información clave sobre evidencias.

descriptions.small: A mother is found dead during Oak Apple Week and Barnaby is sent to investigate.
descriptions.medium: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter.
descriptions.large: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

descriptions.small: Barnaby and Troy investigate the murder of a young woman found strangled in a local woodland.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby and Troy investigate the strangulation of a young woman, whose body was found in the same local woodland where three identical murders took place nine years ago. The case brings them deeper into the world of Midsomer Worthy.
descriptions.large: The naked body of a young woman is found strangled in a local woodland nine years after three identical murders took place there. As DCI Barnaby and DS Troy investigate the killings, they are led further and further into the murky, clandestine world of Midsomer Worthy.

descriptions.small: The sleepy town of Martyr Warren's shady past comes to light after a murder is committed there.
descriptions.medium: Troy and Barnaby try to keep the peace after two rival clans of travellers arrive in the village of Martyr Warren. Barnaby believes there's a connection when Major Hector's found dead.
descriptions.large: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

descriptions.small: Barnaby investigates the murders of a husband and wife near Midsomer Newton.
descriptions.medium: A couple is murdered near a house in Midsomer Newton that is supposedly haunted. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from rumour in order to solve the case.
descriptions.large: With the help of Acting DC Ben Jones, Barnaby investigates the garrotting of a husband and wife outside a deserted cottage near Midsomer Newton. Despite a reputation for being haunted, Winyard is a magnet for villagers, developers and conservationists. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from rumour in order to reveal the cottage's secrets - and catch the killer.

descriptions.small: Barnaby investigates a woman who stands trial for the murder of her best friend.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby begins to doubt the guilt of a woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. Despite overwhelming evidence, Barnaby sets out for the truth.
descriptions.large: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

descriptions.small: Controversial plans to build a supermarket lead to murder, when a man is stabbed to death.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby and Jones investigate the stabbing to death of a man which may be linked to a controversial new supermarket planned for Elverton-cum-Latterly.
descriptions.large: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

descriptions.small: Barnaby is called to investigate the death of an ageing feminist and a misogynist vicar.
descriptions.medium: Chief inspector investigates the puzzling death of ageing feminist, Mildred Danvers, and the misogynist vicar, Rev Gantis.
descriptions.large: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

descriptions.small: A woman's suicide note is e-mailed; a man wants to turn Setwale Wood into houses.
descriptions.medium: The community accepts that a woman's death is suicide, but her suicide note is emailed after her body is found.
descriptions.large: When Susan Bartlett's body is discovered in a wood, villagers assume she killed herself because she could not have children. However, when it comes to light that her suicide note - in the form of an email - was sent too late, Barnaby soon finds himself in the midst of witchcraft, ancient potions, infidelity and land feuds.

descriptions.small: Barnaby and Jones investigate the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall.
descriptions.medium: The appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall prompts Barnaby and Jones to investigate when the horseman foreshadows a number of deaths amongst a family.
descriptions.large: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

descriptions.small: DCI Barnaby investigates the murder of a local property developer who had a malignant brain tumour.
descriptions.medium: The Barnabys plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder of a dying man committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.

descriptions.small: Convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village to quite a hostile welcome.
descriptions.medium: Convicted murderer, Grady Felton, returns to the village to quite a hostile welcome. Later, he is the victim of an arson attack.
descriptions.large: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

descriptions.small: Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, Poulsen and Degn.
descriptions.medium: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn.
descriptions.large: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

EP012606120318.title: The Village That Rose from the Dead

descriptions.small: DCI Barnaby must unravel a web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer.
descriptions.medium: DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer in the ghost village of Little Auburn.

descriptions.tiny: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power.
descriptions.small: Barnaby investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

descriptions.small: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

descriptions.small: Barnaby and Winter find a dead body that's covered in live rabbits.
descriptions.medium: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

descriptions.small: A young woman is found in the woods stabbed to death with a quill at a Jane Austen fantasy event.
descriptions.medium: A journalist who was investigating the village healthcare drone delivery programme is found in the woods stabbed to death by a quill at a Jane Austen weekend event. DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are forced to look back in time to find the culprit.
descriptions.large: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

descriptions.small: The winner of a music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance.
descriptions.medium: Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.

descriptions.small: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute.
descriptions.medium: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute when eldest son Lucian announces plans to break up an estate that's been in his family for centuries.

descriptions.small: A pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for.
descriptions.medium: After a pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into the world of dognapping, cat seduction, and animal investigation.

descriptions.small: When Sleepy Goodman's Land is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues.
descriptions.medium: Sleepy Goodman's Land is known as the Greenest Village in Midsomer. But when the entire village is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues.

descriptions.tiny: An iconic character inspires a killer.
descriptions.small: On Halloween, the team tracks a killer inspired by an iconic character; a blood bank is raided.
descriptions.medium: On Halloween, the team tracks a serial killer inspired by an iconic character; a blood bank is raided by an armed gang.

Soon Kelly and the recovered Wahleeah are caught between Towns' soldiers and the vengeful Sioux.

descriptions.large: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

descriptions.large: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

descriptions.large: Dr. Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) clones Hitler 95 times, and hopes to raise the resulting boys in Brazil, giving them childhoods identical to Hitler's. His ultimate plan is to create a band of Nazi leaders that can continue where Hitler left off, forming the Fourth Reich. Ezra Lieberman (Laurence Olivier), a Nazi hunter, learns of the plan and is determined to thwart it. When the two meet face-to-face in the home of one of the Hitler clones, it is up to the boy to choose who he will assist.

descriptions.large: While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

descriptions.medium: An Asian werewolf (Warner Oland) bites a botanist (Henry Hull) in Tibet and rivals him for the antidote in London.
descriptions.large: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

descriptions.medium: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."
descriptions.large: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

descriptions.medium: A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.

descriptions.tiny: A bitten aristocrat grows fangs, fur, and a muzzle.

descriptions.medium: Bitten by a werewolf, an aristocrat (Lon Chaney) grows fangs, fur and a muzzle, then begs his father (Claude Rains) for help.
descriptions.large: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

descriptions.tiny: An ancient Egyptian is wrapped up with a younger woman.
descriptions.small: Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) walks Cairo streets to find girl (Zita Johann).
descriptions.medium: An Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) searches Cairo for the girl (Zita Johann) he thinks is his long-lost princess.
descriptions.large: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

descriptions.tiny: A couple's newborn turns out to be a lizard-like creature.

descriptions.medium: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.
descriptions.large: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

descriptions.tiny: A framed fugitive learns that his brother has been killed.

descriptions.medium: A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.
descriptions.large: Deputy Jess Carlin (Audie Murphy) leaves his Texas hometown in disgrace, framed by corrupt saloon owner Luke Starr (Broderick Crawford) for a crime he didn't commit. When his brother, muckraking newspaper editor Roy Carlin (Víctor Vilanova), is murdered after printing an exposé of Starr's crooked deals, Carlin returns home from the Mexican border town where he's been holed up and enlists his brother's fiancée (Luz Márquez) and saloon dancer Kit O'Neal (Diana Lorys) to bring Starr down.

descriptions.large: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

descriptions.medium: Twin-brother gynecologists (Jeremy Irons) are divided by a patient (Geneviève Bujold) and doomed by drugs.
descriptions.large: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

descriptions.medium: Miguel gana la estancia de Germán en una partida de póquer, pero la hermana de este se niega a entregársela.

descriptions.medium: Después de una larga ausencia, un hombre regresa a su pueblo y cuenta todas sus aventuras con un toque de nostalgia.

descriptions.medium: A nerd (Eddie Deezen) and his buddies run into a vampire madam (Britt Ekland) and her Hollywood call girls.

descriptions.tiny: A housewife plots revenge on her unfaithful husband.
descriptions.small: Accountant's (Ed Begley Jr.) frumpy wife (Roseanne Barr) hexes him and his mistress (Meryl Streep).
descriptions.medium: An accountant's (Ed Begley Jr.) frumpy wife (Roseanne Barr) hexes him and his fancy mistress (Meryl Streep).
descriptions.large: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

descriptions.small: Un hombre se enamora de una rica heredera y la ayuda a pelear contra su tío ambicioso.
descriptions.medium: Un hombre se enamora de una rica heredera y la ayuda a pelear contra su tío que quiere quedarse con su fortuna.

descriptions.tiny: Monster sandworms devour denizens of a Nevada desert town.
descriptions.small: People (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) flee four big worms with multiple tongues.
descriptions.medium: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.
descriptions.large: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

descriptions.small: Shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork.
descriptions.medium: Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

descriptions.large: In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). While pretending to be a kid-friendly instructor, Kimble falls for pretty fellow teacher Joyce Palmieri (Penelope Ann Miller) as he battles both unruly children and dangerous bad guys.

descriptions.tiny: Un niño busca la venganza por la muerte de toda su familia.
descriptions.small: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

descriptions.medium: Hoping to find a fortune in gold, a boy instead discovers the horrific secrets lurking inside the home of two murderous siblings.
descriptions.large: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

descriptions.large: Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

descriptions.medium: En colegio militar, cuatro jóvenes se hacen amigos y juntos comparten mucho, pero solamente dos de ellos se gradúan.

descriptions.large: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

descriptions.medium: Un casanova es sometido a juicio aunque ya murió. Sus abogados viajan a la Tierra para ver cómo son sus descendientes.
