descriptions.small: Mississippi sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows actress's (Sydne Rome) identity.
descriptions.medium: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

descriptions.tiny: A private eye goes after a drug lord who was presumed dead.
descriptions.small: A former L.A. policeman (Keenen Ivory Wayans) works a case with a DEA agent (Charles S. Dutton).
descriptions.medium: A former Los Angeles policeman (Keenen Ivory Wayans) helps a DEA agent (Charles S. Dutton) on a case similar to the one that ended his career.
descriptions.large: After hitting a wall in his case against drug kingpin Ernesto Mendoza (Andrew Divoff), private eye Andre Shame (Keenen Ivory Wayans) quits the police department in disgrace. The wisecracking investigator thinks he's left his old life behind him, but now everything changes when an old chum from the force informs him of a break in the case. With the help of his motor-mouthed secretary, Peaches (Jada Pinkett), Andre leaps back into the action to solve the case and clear his name.

descriptions.tiny: A renegade gang descends on Cartwright Ponderosa.
descriptions.small: Pinkerton renegade and his gang descend on the Cartwright Ponderosa in pursuit of a reformed outlaw.
descriptions.medium: A Pinkerton renegade (Dennis Farina) and his gang descend on the Cartwright Ponderosa in pursuit of a reformed outlaw (Leonard Nimoy).

descriptions.tiny: Giant subterranean worms surface at a Mexican oil refinery.
descriptions.small: Handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.
descriptions.medium: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.
descriptions.large: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

descriptions.tiny: Un bandido arma una intriga para ser el dueño de un rancho.
descriptions.small: Un grupo de caballeros viven furiosamente e intentan ganar un poco de dinero en el oeste.
descriptions.medium: Un bandido arma una intriga para convertirse en el dueño de un rancho, hasta que los hijos del dueño real lo descubren.

descriptions.tiny: Una mujer sale de vacaciones y ambos esposos son infieles.
descriptions.small: El dueño de una boutique de ropa seduce a hermosas mujeres que intentan conseguir abrigos.
descriptions.medium: Una mujer va de vacaciones y es asediada por un deportista mientas su esposo coquetea con las clientas de su negocio.

descriptions.tiny: A teen faces a bizarre student body at his new school.
descriptions.small: Students (James Marsden, Katie Holmes, Nick Stahl) investigate their too-perfect classmates.
descriptions.medium: High-school students (James Marsden, Katie Holmes, Nick Stahl) suspect that sinister forces are controlling their too-perfect classmates.
descriptions.large: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

descriptions.tiny: The L.A. music scene is the backdrop of a puzzling murder.
descriptions.small: A murder suspect (Shemar Moore) and an aspiring actress (Nia Long) flee killers.
descriptions.medium: A computer whiz (Shemar Moore) suspected of murder seeks an aspiring actress's (Nia Long) help to elude killers and the law.
descriptions.large: Freddy (Shemar Moore) is a big-shot music industry executive, whose cousin, Blusette (Salli Richardson), is a successful and well-known singer managed by 8-Ball Harris (Ernie Hudson). Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him.

descriptions.tiny: Student leads revolt against Japanese invaders.
descriptions.small: A Chinese martial arts student leads his classmates in revolt against Japanese invaders.
descriptions.medium: A Chinese martial arts student leads his classmates in revolt against Japanese invaders who killed their instructor.
descriptions.large: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

descriptions.tiny: Una joven busca alcanzar la fama como cantante de ópera.
descriptions.small: Una hermosa joven trata conquistar el amor de un hombre y la fama como cantante de ópera.
descriptions.medium: Una hermosa joven trata conquistar el amor de un hombre, y busca alcanzar la fama como cantante de ópera.

descriptions.tiny: Gangsters seek control of a Hong Kong shipyard.
descriptions.small: Two men (Ti Lung, Leslie Cheung) meet their dead friend's twin in New York.
descriptions.medium: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

descriptions.tiny: There's something about your first piece.
descriptions.small: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.
descriptions.large: A riotous and raunchy exploration of the most eagerly anticipated -- and most humiliating -- rite of adulthood, known as losing one's virginity. In this hilarious lesson in life, love and libido, a group of friends, fed up with their well-deserved reputations as sexual no-hitters, decide to take action.

descriptions.tiny: He's a cop that's not. Believe that!
descriptions.small: A paroled thief poses as a cop in order to retrieve a gem he hid.
descriptions.medium: A recently paroled thief poses as a cop in order to retrieve a gem he hid in an under-construction police station.
descriptions.large: When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey.

descriptions.tiny: A wedding reunites two almost-lovers from college.
descriptions.small: A writer (Taye Diggs) meets an old flame (Nia Long) at his friend's (Morris Chestnut) wedding.
descriptions.medium: A writer heads to New York to be the best man at a friend's wedding, where he meets up with an old flame.

descriptions.tiny: A suspected lesbian is shipped off to a rehabilitation camp.
descriptions.small: Parents send their teen (Natasha Lyonne) to a rehab camp for homosexuals.
descriptions.medium: Parents send their teenager (Natasha Lyonne) to a rehabilitation camp in the desert because they think she is a lesbian.
descriptions.large: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

descriptions.tiny: Vicious creatures stalk the survivors of a spaceship crash.
descriptions.small: Passengers marooned on a remote planet learn that their only hope is a dangerous escaped convict.
descriptions.medium: Passengers marooned on a remote planet soon learn that their only hope from the deadly creatures lurking in the dark is a dangerous escaped convict. Starring Vin Diesel and Radha Mitchell.
descriptions.large: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

descriptions.tiny: A shy ad designer learns the harsh realities of prison life.
descriptions.small: A man (Tony Leung Ka Fai) befriends another (Chow Yun-Fat) while in prison.
descriptions.medium: Sentenced to two years for accidentally killing a robber, a man (Tony Leung Ka Fai) befriends another prisoner (Chow Yun-Fat) who helps protect him.
descriptions.large: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

descriptions.tiny: Based on the life and tragic death of musician Jimi Hendrix.
descriptions.small: Legendary 1960s guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) dies at 27.
descriptions.medium: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27.

descriptions.small: Un mujeriego va a prisión por enamorar a una menor de edad y una doctora quiere experimentar con él.
descriptions.medium: Un mujeriego va a prisión por enamorar a una menor de edad, al tiempo una doctora quiere experimentar con sus órganos.

descriptions.medium: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

descriptions.tiny: A drag queen shelters a drug addict and her child.

descriptions.medium: A drag queen (Ving Rhames) mourning the loss of his lover takes in a drug addict (Alfre Woodard) and her daughter (Jessika Quynn Reynolds).
descriptions.large: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

descriptions.tiny: Alex Cross probes the kidnapping of a senator's daughter.
descriptions.small: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate an abduction.
descriptions.medium: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.
descriptions.large: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

Fall into fabulous savings with Shop LC's Autumn clearance; The final sale offers incredible savings on seasonal favorites; From cozy sweaters to stylish accessories, reap the rewards of unbeatable discounts and prepare for a stylish autumn.

descriptions.large: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

descriptions.tiny: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo.
descriptions.medium: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

descriptions.medium: Hipólito es un pianista ciego que ofrece refugio a una joven desvalida llamada Santa. Él se enamora de la chica y hace todo lo posible para que no se dé cuenta de su ceguera al conocer su casa a la perfección, pero un error terminará con la ilusión.

descriptions.medium: La esposa de un cantante se vuelve vedette e intenta engañarlo con un cantante venezolano, que resulta ser su amigo.

descriptions.tiny: Thugs chase a teen they think kidnapped a rap artist.
descriptions.small: A teen (Sam Jones III) must elude thugs after a rapper (Nelly) disappears.
descriptions.medium: A teenager (Sam Jones III) must elude thugs who believe he is responsible for the disappearance of a rapper (Nelly) and an unfinished album.
descriptions.large: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

descriptions.medium: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

descriptions.tiny: A cattle baron meets his match in a strong-willed woman.
descriptions.small: Cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame wife (Maureen O'Hara).
descriptions.medium: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.
descriptions.large: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

descriptions.tiny: Un hombre viaja a la capital y visita clubes nocturnos.
descriptions.small: Un hombre viaja a la capital para visitar clubes nocturnos, pero se encuentra con su esposa.
descriptions.medium: Un hombre puritano viaja a la capital para visitar clubes nocturnos y se presenta como soltero, pero, para su sorpresa, se encuentra allí con su esposa.

descriptions.tiny: Un matrimonio llega a su hacienda y encuentra disturbios.

descriptions.medium: Al volver de su luna de miel, un matrimonio es recibido con música en su hacienda, pero también con enredos y altercados.

descriptions.small: Cowboy (Rory Calhoun) thwarts businessman, gold thief (John Russell).
descriptions.medium: A cowboy (Rory Calhoun) thwarts a businessman and a thief (John Russell) out to rob gold from a stage station.

descriptions.tiny: Sansón escoge a la mujer equivocada por esposa.
descriptions.small: Un relato sobre Sansón y cómo escogió a la mujer equivocada por esposa.
descriptions.medium: Un relato sobre Sansón y cómo escogió a la mujer equivocada por esposa rechazando a la hermosa Dalila.

descriptions.medium: Una mujer fea toma un brebaje que la vuelve hermosa temporalmente, pero todo el que la vea en estado de fealdad, morirá.

descriptions.tiny: Four friends from high school become powerful drug kingpins.
descriptions.small: Four drug dealers (Allen Payne, Aaron D. Spears) face the wrath of a kingpin.
descriptions.medium: Four Boston friends (Allen Payne, Aaron D. Spears) become big-time drug dealers but face the wrath of another kingpin.
descriptions.large: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

descriptions.tiny: A man hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms.
descriptions.small: A man (Michael Gross) hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms.
descriptions.medium: A man (Michael Gross) hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms that are terrorizing a mining town in the 1800s.
descriptions.large: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

descriptions.tiny: Los pequeños hijos de dos amigos son confundidos al nacer.
descriptions.small: Dos recién nacidos son confundidos al nacer y los padres se sienten mutuamente traicionados.
descriptions.medium: Dos recién nacidos son confundidos al nacer y los padres se sienten mutuamente traicionados hasta que todo se aclara.

descriptions.tiny: Un niño español viaja a México en busca de su padre.
descriptions.medium: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

descriptions.tiny: Una joven conoce a un ex convicto que la hace estrella.
descriptions.medium: Una joven mesera conoce a un ex productor de cine que acaba de salir de prisión y la hace estrella de cine.

descriptions.tiny: Un mal hombre enamora y embaraza a una joven decente.
descriptions.small: Un mal hombre enamora y embaraza a una joven decente e incluso la involucra en un fraude.
descriptions.medium: Un mal hombre enamora y embaraza a una joven decente e incluso la involucra en un fraude, pero al tiempo se arrepiente.

descriptions.tiny: A man is obsessed with the desire to capture a mustang.
descriptions.small: Ranchers (Joel McCrea, Race Gentry) catch stallion for girl (Mari Blanchard) and her uncle.
descriptions.medium: Two ranchers (Joel McCrea, Race Gentry) catch and break a wild black stallion for a girl (Mari Blanchard) and her uncle.

descriptions.tiny: Coming to the rescue.
descriptions.small: An adventurer (Bill Paxton) and his family battle a criminal.
descriptions.medium: An adventurer (Bill Paxton) and his family battle a criminal mastermind after he attacks their base and plans to rob the world's largest banks.
descriptions.large: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

descriptions.tiny: You think you know who you are. You have no idea.
descriptions.small: Racial tensions collide in a collection of intertwined stories involving residents of Los Angeles.
descriptions.large: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

descriptions.tiny: Dakota scout (Van Heflin) objects to cavalry methods.
descriptions.small: A Dakota scout disagrees with a cavalry lieutenant about the best way to avoid a massacre.
descriptions.medium: A Dakota scout (Van Heflin) disagrees with a cavalry lieutenant (Alex Nicol) about the best way to avoid a massacre.

descriptions.tiny: A man dumps his lover's corpse in an already occupied grave.
descriptions.small: A man (Andrew Scott) dumps his lover's corpse in an already occupied grave.
descriptions.medium: Events spin out of control after a young man (Andrew Scott) deposits his lover's corpse in a shallow grave that is already occupied.
descriptions.large: The reappearance of his ex-girlfriend Jean (Katy Davis) threatens to put a damper on Tommy's (Andrew Scott) happy bachelorhood -- but he gets far more than he bargained for when he returns to his apartment to find her dead body. Fearful of becoming a murder suspect, Tommy hatches a plan with pal Noel (Darren Healy) to dispose of the body. But his perfect plan unravels when police dogs track down two corpses in the same place: Jean's, and that of a prominent politician's wife.

descriptions.tiny: Una joven oculta la infidelidad de la esposa de su jefe.
descriptions.small: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y ella no la delata.
descriptions.medium: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y para ayudar dice que es suyo, pero el patrón descubre todo.

descriptions.tiny: Nobody believes a liar ... even when he's telling the truth.
descriptions.small: Murders occur when teens (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) invent a story about a killer.
descriptions.medium: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

descriptions.tiny: Flesh-eating zombies threaten a fortified city.
descriptions.small: A mercenary leader squares off with a rebellious comrade, while zombies threaten their city.
descriptions.medium: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.
descriptions.large: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

descriptions.tiny: A spaceship crew gets caught in a deadly conflict.
descriptions.small: A spaceship crew (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) gets caught in a deadly conflict.
descriptions.medium: Crew members (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) aboard a transport vessel get caught in a deadly conflict in the wake of a galactic war.
descriptions.large: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

descriptions.tiny: Tras un accidente, una joven hereda una gran fortuna.
descriptions.small: Una joven hereda una gran fortuna, por lo que un hombre se aprovecha del amor que despertó en ella.
descriptions.medium: Tras un accidente, una joven hereda una gran fortuna, por lo que un hombre se aprovecha del amor que despertó en ella.

descriptions.tiny: How did a crime with this many witnesses go so far?
descriptions.small: A teenage drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) kidnaps the younger brother of a debt-ridden junkie.
descriptions.medium: A teenage dealer (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother of a junkie who won't pay for the drugs.
descriptions.large: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

descriptions.tiny: Una maestra acompaña a sus alumnas a un paseo al campo.
descriptions.small: Una maestra pasa unas vacaciones de verano con sus alumnas y sus padres en un rancho.
descriptions.medium: Una maestra es invitada por los padres de algunas de sus alumnas a pasar las vacaciones de verano en un rancho.

MV001776870000.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman

descriptions.tiny: Find yourself. In love.
descriptions.small: A professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) falls for a younger man (Paul Rudd).
descriptions.medium: A professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) falls for a younger man (Paul Rudd), while her daughter falls in love for the first time.
descriptions.large: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

descriptions.tiny: Two brothers set out to rid Boston of its criminal element.
descriptions.small: Brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus) begin killing off Boston's underworld.
descriptions.medium: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.
descriptions.large: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner (Sean Patrick Flanery) and Murphy (Norman Reedus) are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community. But Paul Smecker (Willem Dafoe), an eccentric FBI agent, is fast closing in on their blood-soaked trail.

descriptions.tiny: Four martial artists unite against a sinister force.
descriptions.small: The world's deadliest assassins will enter. Only the best will survive.
descriptions.medium: Four rivals (Devon Aoki, Jaime Pressly, Sarah Carter, Holly Valance) at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat.
descriptions.large: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

descriptions.tiny: Hit men converge on Lake Tahoe to rub out a mob informant.
descriptions.small: Two FBI agents must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) who has agreed to testify against the mob.
descriptions.medium: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.
descriptions.large: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

descriptions.tiny: No children. No future. No hope.
descriptions.small: A disillusioned bureaucrat becomes an unlikely champion in the fight for mankind's survival.
descriptions.medium: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction, a disillusioned bureaucrat becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population.
descriptions.large: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

descriptions.tiny: In order to get the girl, he's gotta get his shift together.
descriptions.small: A beauty spurs a slacker (Dane Cook) and a co-worker (Dax Shepard) to compete for a coveted award.
descriptions.medium: The chance of a date with a beautiful new cashier (Jessica Simpson) sends two store clerks (Dane Cook, Dax Shepard) into fierce competition for a coveted award.
descriptions.large: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

descriptions.tiny: A young man whose fiancée died begins dating again.
descriptions.small: A young man (Jason Biggs), whose fiancée died of fright, begins dating again.
descriptions.medium: A year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) begins dating a waitress (Isla Fisher) who has quirks of her own.
descriptions.large: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

descriptions.tiny: A former rodeo champ leaves his family to join a roundup.
descriptions.small: Ex-rodeo rider (Kenny Rogers) goes to round-up without his family.
descriptions.medium: An ex-rodeo rider (Kenny Rogers) leaves his family in Texas and goes to Wyoming for a government round-up.

descriptions.tiny: You scream. You die.
descriptions.small: A man returns to his haunted hometown to unravel the mystery surrounding his wife's death.
descriptions.medium: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.
descriptions.large: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

descriptions.tiny: Spiked-hair punk teens offend a community.
descriptions.small: Teens offend a community with their spiked hair, filth and punk lifestyle.
descriptions.medium: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

descriptions.tiny: You are now infected.
descriptions.small: Sinister supernatural forces are behind a popular new Website.
descriptions.medium: Some friends think a new Website is just a hoax with a clever marketing campaign until everyone who logs on dies.
descriptions.large: After her boyfriend commits suicide, a psychology student (Kristen Bell) and her friends begin receiving unsettling e-mails and video messages. After a number of disappearances across campus, she teams up with a computer hacker (Ian Somerhalder) to shut down the deadly force before it spreads to the rest of the world.

descriptions.tiny: A cunning serial killer victimizes two traveling students.
descriptions.small: A killer (Sean Bean) terrorizes two students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) who give him a ride.
descriptions.medium: Two traveling students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) pick up a hitchhiker (Sean Bean), unaware that he is a serial killer who intends to pin his crimes on them.
descriptions.large: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

descriptions.tiny: An incorrigible teen goes to live with her stern grandma.
descriptions.small: Mother. Daughter. Grandmother. In this family, attitude doesn't skip a generation.
descriptions.medium: Exasperated with her rebellious daughter (Lindsay Lohan), a woman (Felicity Huffman) sends the teen to Idaho to live with her own stern mother (Jane Fonda).
descriptions.large: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

descriptions.tiny: A veteran stuntman uses his car to kill unsuspecting women.
descriptions.small: Mike is a professional body double who uses his car to stalk and kill young women in the South.
descriptions.medium: Mike is a professional body double who uses his car to stalk and kill unsuspecting young women in the South.
descriptions.large: Stuntman Mike is a professional body double who likes to take unsuspecting women for deadly drives in his free time. He has doctored his car for maximum impact; when Mike purposely causes wrecks, the bodies pile up while he walks away with barely a scratch. The insane Mike may be in over his head, though, when he targets a tough group of female friends, including real-life stuntwoman Zoe Bell (who served as Uma Thurman's double in "Kill Bill"), who plays herself.

descriptions.tiny: A mad composer haunts the sewers under a Paris opera house.
descriptions.small: Acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has dwarf kidnap opera singer (Heather Sears).
descriptions.medium: An acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has his dwarf helper bring an opera singer (Heather Sears) to his London sewer hide-out.
descriptions.large: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

descriptions.tiny: A madman tries to restore his daughter's mutilated face.
descriptions.small: A surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with stolen skin.
descriptions.medium: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.
descriptions.large: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

descriptions.tiny: Un joven reclama a su exnovia porque se casó con otro.
descriptions.small: Un joven tiene que partir y, cuando vuelve, su exnovia está casada con otro.
descriptions.medium: Un joven tiene que partir y, cuando vuelve, su exnovia está casada con otro. Por esta razón, le reclama que su amor fue flor de un día.

descriptions.tiny: A policewoman seeks the source of a batch of cocaine.
descriptions.small: Drug dealer wants bodyguard (Sam Elliott) to stop L.A. policewoman (Whoopi Goldberg).
descriptions.medium: A big-time drug dealer sends his bodyguard (Sam Elliott) to stop a Los Angeles policewoman (Whoopi Goldberg) who's bad for business.
descriptions.large: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

descriptions.tiny: Most people respect the badge. Everybody respects the gun.
descriptions.small: Two veteran detectives hunt a vigilante serial killer whose crimes resemble someone else's.
descriptions.medium: Two veteran detectives hunt a vigilante whose crimes resemble those of a killer they put behind bars long ago.
descriptions.large: Detectives Thomas Cowan (Robert De Niro) and David Fisk (Al Pacino), 30-year veterans of the NYPD, investigate the murder of a pimp. The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

descriptions.tiny: Un hombre casado busca pasar una divertida noche de soltero.
descriptions.small: Un hombre casado busca pasar una divertida noche de soltero y se enfrenta a la peor pesadilla.
descriptions.medium: Un hombre casado busca pasar una divertida noche de soltero y por su infidelidad se enfrenta a la peor pesadilla de su vida.

descriptions.tiny: The owner of a bait shop competes in a fishing tournament.
descriptions.small: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a bait shop competes in a fishing tournament.
descriptions.medium: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a small-town bait shop competes in a fishing tournament for the prize money to save his business.

descriptions.tiny: La historia del futbolista argentino Alfredo di Stéfano.
descriptions.small: La historia del futbolista argentino Alfredo di Stéfano en dos versiones.

descriptions.tiny: A delivery man gives a package of drugs to the wrong people.
descriptions.small: A delivery man (Donald Faison) accidentally brings a box full of cocaine to the wrong address.
descriptions.medium: A courier (Donald Faison) lands in the middle of a drug deal gone awry when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address.
descriptions.large: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.

descriptions.tiny: A man braves a ghost invasion to find his missing daughter.
descriptions.small: A man (Jamie Bamber) braves an invasion of ghosts to find his missing daughter.
descriptions.medium: Searching for his missing daughter, a man (Jamie Bamber) wanders through a world inhabited by ghosts that used the Internet to invade the land of the living.

descriptions.tiny: Ghosts threaten the extinction of the human race.
descriptions.small: When a teenager opens a laptop, ghosts threaten the extinction of the human race.

descriptions.tiny: FBI agents investigate the rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.small: FBI agents (Julia Ormond, Bill Pullman) investigate the bloody rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.medium: FBI agents (Julia Ormond, Bill Pullman) interrogate witnesses who survive the bloody rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.large: After a spree of horrific murders in the New Mexico desert, two FBI agents arrive at a small Santa Fe police station to interview the key witnesses. Using elaborate surveillance equipment to view the interrogations simultaneously, Sam Hallaway watches as his partner cross-examines the three survivors. As several inconsistencies emerge, it becomes clear that somebody in the room knows the truth behind the slayings.

descriptions.tiny: Never ride with a stranger.
descriptions.small: Two friends become caught up in an airport shuttle driver's (Tony Curran) deadly game.
descriptions.medium: Two friends (Cameron Goodman, Peyton List) become caught up in an airport shuttle driver's (Tony Curran) deadly game.
descriptions.large: Best friends Mel (Peyton List) and Jules (Cameron Goodman) are returning from a holiday in Mexico when they board an airport shuttle in the States. It's there they join two young men and an older business executive in what they believe to be a short journey home. But when the driver (Tony Curran) makes an unexpected detour into a dark and uninviting section of the city, it becomes clear the shuttle is taking its unwitting passengers somewhere else entirely.

descriptions.tiny: A power couple has a surprise pregnancy.
descriptions.small: A power couple has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin.
descriptions.medium: A power couple (Jerry O'Connell, Heather Graham) has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin.

descriptions.tiny: British twin sisters attend school in California.
descriptions.small: British twin sisters (Milly Rosso, Becky Rosso) attend school in California.
descriptions.medium: British twin sisters (Milly Rosso, Becky Rosso) experience culture shock when they attend school in California.

descriptions.tiny: A rookie reporter tries to solve a series of murders.
descriptions.small: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) tries to solve a series of child abductions.
descriptions.medium: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a missing-child case that mirrors that of a series of child abductions and murders that took place in previous years.
descriptions.large: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

descriptions.tiny: Drácula despierta de su tumba para reclamar más víctimas.
descriptions.medium: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

descriptions.tiny: Not all souls can be saved.
descriptions.small: Two medieval knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused sorceress to a remote abbey.
descriptions.medium: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.
descriptions.large: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

MV002706110000.title: St Trinian's 2: The Legend of Fritton's Gold

descriptions.tiny: The girls of St. Trinians hunt for buried treasure.
descriptions.small: The girls of St. Trinians hunt for treasure after discovering Miss Fritton is related to a pirate.
descriptions.medium: The girls of St. Trinians hunt for buried treasure after discovering Miss Fritton is related to a pirate.

descriptions.tiny: College students mistake two scruffy pals for killers.
descriptions.small: Obnoxious college students mistake two scruffy pals for murderous hillbillies.
descriptions.medium: Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.

descriptions.tiny: One hot pistol. One hired gun. One loose cannon.
descriptions.small: A hit man (Bill Nighy) decides not to kill his intended victim (Emily Blunt).
descriptions.medium: Longing to get out of the assassination business, a hit man (Bill Nighy) decides not to follow through with his latest assignment to kill a pretty art thief (Emily Blunt).

descriptions.tiny: Don't look up.
descriptions.small: Strange lights descending on Los Angeles herald the arrival of malevolent extraterrestrials.
descriptions.medium: Strange lights over Los Angeles herald the arrival of malevolent aliens who threaten to swallow up humanity.
descriptions.large: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

descriptions.tiny: A white shark hunts the crew of a capsized sailboat.
descriptions.small: Friends on a sailing trip meet disaster when their boat sinks and a white shark hunts them.
descriptions.medium: A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

descriptions.tiny: A betrayed man seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.
descriptions.small: A betrayed man (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.
descriptions.medium: With help from a gangster, a betrayed man (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.

descriptions.tiny: A young woman has premonitions of murders.
descriptions.small: A young woman has premonitions of murders that seem to be related to the paintings of Caravaggio.
descriptions.medium: A young woman with a dark past makes her vows to enter the nun hood and begins having premonitions of murders that seem to be related to the paintings of Caravaggio.

descriptions.tiny: A teenager battles werewolves and his own lust for blood.
descriptions.small: A teenager (Landon Liboiron) battles a pack of werewolves and his own lust for blood.
descriptions.medium: Heir to a line of werewolves, a teenager (Landon Liboiron) battles a pack of beasts and his own lust for blood.

MV003746150000.title: Fred 2: Night of the Living Fred

descriptions.tiny: A teenager thinks that his new neighbor is a vampire.
descriptions.small: A teenager (Lucas Cruikshank) thinks that his new neighbor (Seth Morris) is a vampire.
descriptions.medium: A teenager (Lucas Cruikshank) tries to convince everyone that his new neighbor (Seth Morris) is a vampire.

descriptions.tiny: Un padre educa severamente a sus nueve hijos.
descriptions.small: Un modesto médico educa severamente a sus nueve hijos, y les enseña altos valores morales.
descriptions.medium: Cuando su hijo se enamora, una mujer divorciada sufre una crisis existencial que pone en riesgo su segundo matrimonio.

descriptions.tiny: An indebted grifter launches a website that exploits women.
descriptions.small: To pay his gambling debts, a grifter (C. Thomas Howell) launches a website that exploits women.

descriptions.tiny: Newlyweds stranded in Bavaria encounter a cult of vampires.
descriptions.small: Professor (Clifford Evans) rescues 1910 newlyweds from doctor's (Noel Willman) vampire villa.
descriptions.medium: A professor (Clifford Evans) in black rescues stranded 1910 newlyweds from a Bavarian doctor's (Noel Willman) vampire villa.

descriptions.tiny: Drug-addled college dropouts must thwart an invasion.
descriptions.small: Flashbacks reveal how two drug-addled college dropouts saved the world from a silent invasion.
descriptions.medium: A new drug promises out-of-body experiences, but users are coming back changed forever, and an otherworldly invasion of Earth is underway.

descriptions.tiny: A young woman strives to be a professional dancer in Miami.
descriptions.small: Dancers band together to save their historic neighborhood from a developer.
descriptions.medium: Newly arrived in Miami, an aspiring dancer (Kathryn McCormick) joins forces with the leader (Ryan Guzman) of a flash-mob dance crew to save the historic neighborhood from a developer.
descriptions.large: Newly arrived in Miami, young dancer Emily (Kathryn McCormick) dreams of becoming a professional. She soon meets and falls in love with Sean (Ryan Guzman), the leader of a dance crew called "the Mob." When a rich businessman's plans to develop the dancers' historic neighborhood threatens to displace thousands of people, Emily must join forces with Sean and the Mob to turn their performance art into protest art, even though doing so may place her dreams in jeopardy.

descriptions.tiny: Three people become trapped by an unknown assailant.
descriptions.small: Three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) become trapped by an unknown assailant.
descriptions.medium: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

descriptions.tiny: A supernatural force lurks in two sisters' childhood home.
descriptions.small: A woman contends with a supernatural force and her sister's disappearance.
descriptions.medium: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

descriptions.tiny: The first real ghost story.
descriptions.small: Paranormal investigators come face-to-face with an angry spirit more terrifying than any other.
descriptions.medium: Hired to debunk a supposed haunting, paranormal investigators come face-to-face with an angry spirit more terrifying than they have ever imagined.

descriptions.tiny: Earth is a memory worth fighting for.
descriptions.small: A stranger's arrival triggers one man's battle to save mankind.
descriptions.medium: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.
descriptions.large: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

descriptions.tiny: 7 pistoleros viajan por el desierto en busca de El Dorado.
descriptions.small: Siete pistoleros viajan por el desierto y luchan por sobrevivir mientras buscan El Dorado.

descriptions.tiny: 200 years later, he's still alive.
descriptions.small: Still alive in modern times, Frankenstein's creature becomes enmeshed in a war involving immortals.
descriptions.medium: Still alive in modern times, Frankenstein's creature (Aaron Eckhart) becomes caught in the middle, as gargoyles and demons wage war for the souls of mankind.
descriptions.large: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

descriptions.tiny: Un sacerdote y una monja compiten.
descriptions.small: Un sacerdote y una monja compiten para probar quién de ellos es el más bondadoso.
descriptions.medium: Una monja llega a un pueblo y tiene problemas con el sacerdote, debido a su comportamiento poco ortodoxo, pero, finalmente, ambos comprenden que persiguen el mismo fin: ayudar a las personas.

descriptions.tiny: Every diva deserves an encore.
descriptions.small: A once-popular opera diva (Maggie Smith) reunites with her ex-husband at a retirement home.
descriptions.medium: A long-smoldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star (Maggie Smith) reunites with her ex-husband (Tom Courtenay) and fellow performers (Billy Connolly, Pauline Collins) at a retirement home for musicians.
descriptions.large: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

descriptions.tiny: A werewolf hunts down villagers one by one.
descriptions.small: A werewolf hunts down villagers one by one, and Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them.
descriptions.medium: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

descriptions.tiny: A Latina rapper faces a hard choice about a record deal.
descriptions.small: A Latina rapper faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself.
descriptions.medium: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

descriptions.tiny: A racehorse helps a teenage girl overcome a tragic loss.
descriptions.small: A teenager overcomes a tragic loss by working with a racehorse trainer and his talented runner.
descriptions.medium: A teenager (Julianne Michelle) overcomes a tragic loss by working with a talented racehorse and establishing a relationship with the mother (Claire Forlani) she never knew.

descriptions.tiny: Un cazador de tiburones busca un tesoro escondido en el mar.
descriptions.small: Un famoso cazador de tiburones se une con un muchacho para encontrar un tesoro escondido en el mar.

MV004497930000.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia

descriptions.tiny: A family discovers something else residing in the house.
descriptions.small: A historic Southern home's new residents come face to face with a malevolent force.
descriptions.medium: A historic Southern home's new residents (Abigail Spencer, Chad Michael Murray) come face to face with a malevolent force.

descriptions.tiny: A mutual ex-lover brings together a group of strangers.
descriptions.small: A mutual ex-lover brings together a group of strangers at a bar in downtown Los Angeles.
descriptions.medium: A mutual ex-lover (Katee Sackhoff) brings together a group of strangers at a bar in downtown Los Angeles.

descriptions.tiny: Two words can change everything.
descriptions.small: A gay Briton living in New York marries his lesbian friend to remain in the country.
descriptions.medium: A gay Briton living in New York risks losing his family and residency in the United States. He marries a lesbian friend to remain in the country, but things get complicated when he meets the love of his life.

descriptions.tiny: A youth overhears a shocking confession.
descriptions.small: A mentally impaired youth with an uncanny memory is asked to testify as a defense witness.
descriptions.medium: A mentally impaired youth who interacts with beings he calls "watchers" is asked to testify as a defense witness at a criminal trial.

descriptions.tiny: This is not a game.
descriptions.small: An unusually gifted youth is selected for advanced training to defend Earth against alien invaders.
descriptions.medium: After an alien invasion, an unlikely recruit commands Earth's forces and fights for the future of humanity.
descriptions.large: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

descriptions.tiny: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles an orchestra of space scientists.
descriptions.small: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles the world's first orchestra made up of space scientists.
LA Xtreme gives you an inside look at their team and processes.

descriptions.tiny: An alien bacterium turns those it infects into zombies.
descriptions.small: Astronauts on Mars become infected with a microbe that turns them into zombielike killers.
descriptions.medium: Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.

descriptions.tiny: They suck at school.
descriptions.small: A human/vampire teen is in training to become a guardian for her best friend, a vampire princess.
descriptions.medium: At a secret boarding school, a half-human/half-vampire teenager (Zoey Deutch) trains to become a guardian for her best friend -- a vampire princess (Lucy Fry).
descriptions.large: Teenager Rose Hathaway (Zoey Deutch) is a Dhampir -- a human/vampire hybrid. Her best friend is Lissa Dragomir (Lucy Fry), a princess of the Moroi -- mortal, peaceful vampires. Both teens attend St. Vladimir's Academy, a secret haven for those like them. Rose trains with a handsome mentor (Danila Kozlovsky) to guarantee her place as Lissa's guardian -- although she may have to sacrifice everything to protect Lissa from enemies both within St. Vladimir's walls and outside them.

descriptions.tiny: A man embarks on a global search for a set of mystic relics.
descriptions.small: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) searches for a set of 12 Chinese zodiac bronze heads.
descriptions.medium: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

descriptions.tiny: A teen and his gay friend set out to lose their virginity.
descriptions.small: Two best friends' pact to lose their virginity takes an unexpected turn when one announces he's gay.
descriptions.medium: Two high-school seniors make a pact to help each other lose their virginity before their prom, but their mission takes an unexpected turn when one announces that he's gay.

descriptions.tiny: A model's murder brings together a photographer and a cop.
descriptions.small: A model's murder brings together a fetish photographer and a homicide detective.
descriptions.medium: A fetish photographer and a homicide detective develop an unlikely friendship as they probe the murder of a model.

descriptions.tiny: Catana Starks coaches a college men's golf team.
descriptions.small: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team.
descriptions.medium: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

descriptions.tiny: The National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity.
descriptions.small: Filmmaker James Costa investigates the National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity.
descriptions.medium: Filmmaker James Costa investigates the National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity, and shows what schools, parents, authors, doctors, politicians, celebrities, and chefs are doing to combat the problem.

descriptions.tiny: Five strangers band together to survive a night of mayhem.
descriptions.small: Five strangers must band together to survive a night of government-sanctioned carnage.
descriptions.medium: Three groups of people intertwine and are left stranded in the streets on Purge Night, trying to survive the chaos and violence that occurs.
descriptions.large: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

MV005664310000.title: Love in the Time of Monsters

descriptions.tiny: Two sisters battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes.
descriptions.small: Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes.
descriptions.medium: Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes to save the ones they love.

descriptions.tiny: Competitive puzzlers prepare for a large contest.
descriptions.small: Top teams in competitive puzzling prepare for the largest contest in the country.

descriptions.tiny: A sleepwalking bride undergoes a frightening transformation.
descriptions.small: A newlywed (Rose Leslie) comes back frighteningly different after sleepwalking in the woods.
descriptions.medium: A honeymooning bride (Rose Leslie) goes sleepwalking into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns she looks the same, but something about her is frighteningly different.

descriptions.tiny: Welcome to a new world of gods and monsters.
descriptions.small: A soldier of fortune battles an ancient, resurrected princess as she embarks on a rampage in London.
descriptions.medium: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.
descriptions.large: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

descriptions.tiny: You either know one, you have one, or you are one.
descriptions.small: A teen vows to reinvent herself after learning that she's been given an embarrassing nickname.
descriptions.medium: A high-school senior (Mae Whitman) sets out to reinvent herself and revolutionize the student body's social order after learning that a judgmental classmate has given her an embarrassing nickname.
descriptions.large: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

descriptions.tiny: A Brooklyn gang member takes a teen under his wing.
